verses.sa:
ओ चित् सखायं सख्या ववृत्यां तिरः पुरु चिदर्णवं जगन्वान्।
पितुर्नपातमा दधीत वेधा अधि क्षमि प्रतरं दीध्यानः॥
verses.tr: o cit sakhāyaṃ sakhyā vavṛtyāṃ tiraḥ puru cidarṇavaṃ jaganvān piturnapātamā dadhīta vedhā adhi kṣami prataraṃ dīdhyānaḥ
verses.en: Pain would I win my friend to kindly friendship. So may the Sage, come through the air's wide ocean; Remembering the earth and days to follow, obtain a son the issue of his father.

verses.sa:
न ते सखा सख्यं वष्ट्येतत् सलक्ष्मा यद् विषुरूपा भवाति ।
महस्पुत्रासो असुरस्य वीरा दिवो धर्तार उर्विया परि ख्यन्॥
verses.tr: na te sakhā sakhyaṃ vaṣṭyetat salakṣmā yad viṣurūpā bhavāti mahasputrāso asurasya vīrā divo dhartāra urviyā pari khyan
verses.en: Thy friend loves not the friendship which considers her who is near in kindred as a stranger. Sons of the mighty Asura, the heroes, supporters of the heaven, see far around them.

verses.sa:
उशन्ति घा ते अमृतास एतदेकस्य चित् त्यजसं मर्त्यस्य ।
नि ते मनो मनसि धाय्यस्मे जन्युः पतिस्तन्व१मा विविश्याः॥
verses.tr: uśanti ghā te amṛtāsa etadekasya cit tyajasaṃ martyasya ni te mano manasi dhāyyasme janyuḥ patistanva1mā viviśyāḥ
verses.en: Yea, this the Immortals seek of thee with longing, a scion of the only man existing. Then let thy soul and mine be knit together. Embrace thy consort as her loving husband,

verses.sa:
न यत् पुरा चकृमा कद्ध नूनमृतं वदन्तो अनृतं रपेम ।
गन्धर्वो अप्स्वप्या च योषा सा नौ नाभिः परमं जामि तन्नौ॥
verses.tr: na yat purā cakṛmā kaddha nūnamṛtaṃ vadanto anṛtaṃ rapema gandharvo apsvapyā ca yoṣā sā nau nābhiḥ paramaṃ jāmi tannau
verses.en: Shall we do now what we ne'er did aforetime? we who spake righteously now talk impurely? Gandharva in the floods, the Dame of Waters—such is our bond, such our most lofty kinship.

verses.sa:
गर्भे नु नौ जनिता दम्पती कर्देवस्त्वष्टा सविता विश्वरूपः ।
नकिरस्य प्र मिनन्ति व्रतानि वेद नावस्य पृथिवी उत द्यौः॥
verses.tr: garbhe nu nau janitā dampatī kardevastvaṣṭā savitā viśvarūpaḥ nakirasya pra minanti vratāni veda nāvasya pṛthivī uta dyauḥ
verses.en: Even in the womb God Tvashtar, vivifier, shaping all forms, Creator, made us consorts, Ne'er are his holy statutes violated: that we are his the heaven and earth acknowledge.

verses.sa:
को अद्य युङ्क्ते धुरि गा ऋतस्य शिमीवतो भामिनो दुर्हृणायून्।
आसन्निषून् हृत्स्वसो मयोभून् य एषां भृत्यामृणधत् स जीवात्॥
verses.tr: ko adya yuṅkte dhuri gā ṛtasya śimīvato bhāmino durhṛṇāyūn āsanniṣūn hṛtsvaso mayobhūn ya eṣāṃ bhṛtyāmṛṇadhat sa jīvāt
verses.en: Who yokes to-day unto the pole of Order the strong and passionate steers of checkless spirit, With shaft-armed mouths, heart-piercing, joy-bestowing? Long shall he live who duly pays them service,

verses.sa:
को अस्य वेद प्रथमस्याह्नः क ईं ददर्श क इह प्र वोचत्।
बृहन्मित्रस्य वरुणस्य धाम कदु ब्रव आहनो वीच्या नॄन्॥
verses.tr: ko asya veda prathamasyāhnaḥ ka īṃ dadarśa ka iha pra vocat bṛhanmitrasya varuṇasya dhāma kadu brava āhano vīcyā nṝn
verses.en: Who knows that earliest day whereof thou speakest? Who hath beheld it? Who can here declare it? Great is the law of Varuna and Mitra, What, wanton, wilt thou say to men to tempt them?

verses.sa:
यमस्य मा यम्यं काम आगन्त्समाने योनौ सहशेय्याय ।
जायेव पत्ये तन्वं रिरिच्यां वि चिद् वृहेव रथ्येव चक्रा॥
verses.tr: yamasya mā yamyaṃ kāma āgantsamāne yonau sahaśeyyāya jāyeva patye tanvaṃ riricyāṃ vi cid vṛheva rathyeva cakrā
verses.en: I Yami am possessed by love of Yama, that I may rest on the same couch beside him. I as a wife would yield me to my husband, Like car-wheels let us speed to meet each other.

verses.sa:
न तिष्ठन्ति न नि मिषन्त्येते देवानां स्पश इह ये चरन्ति ।
अन्येन मदाहनो याहि तूयं तेन वि वृह रथ्येव चक्रा॥
verses.tr: na tiṣṭhanti na ni miṣantyete devānāṃ spaśa iha ye caranti anyena madāhano yāhi tūyaṃ tena vi vṛha rathyeva cakrā
verses.en: They stand not still, they never close their eyelids, those sentinels of Gods who wander round us. Not me—go quickly, wanton, with another, and hasten like a chariot-wheel to meet him.

verses.sa:
रात्रीभिरस्मा अहभिर्दशस्येत् सूर्यस्य चक्षुर्मुहुरुन्मिमीयात्।
दिवा पृथिव्या मिथुना सबन्धू यमीर्यमस्य विवृहादजामि॥
verses.tr: rātrībhirasmā ahabhirdaśasyet sūryasya cakṣurmuhurunmimīyāt divā pṛthivyā mithunā sabandhū yamīryamasya vivṛhādajāmi
verses.en: May Surya's eye with days and nights endow him, and ever may his light spread out before him. In heaven and earth the kindred pair commingle. On Yami be the unbrotherly act of Yama.

verses.sa:
आ घा ता गच्छानुत्तरा युगानि यत्र जामयः कृणवन्नजामि ।
उप बर्बृहि वृषभाय बाहुमन्यमिच्छस्व सुभगे पतिं मत्॥
verses.tr: ā ghā tā gacchānuttarā yugāni yatra jāmayaḥ kṛṇavannajāmi upa barbṛhi vṛṣabhāya bāhumanyamicchasva subhage patiṃ mat
verses.en: Sure there will come succeeding times when brothers and sisters will do acts unmeet for kinsfolk, Not me, O fair one—seek another husband, and make thine arm a pillow for thy consort.

verses.sa:
किं भ्रातासद् यदनाथं भवाति किमु स्वसा यन्निरृतिर्निगच्छात्।
काममूता बह्वे३तद् रपामि तन्वाऽमे तन्वं१ सं पिपृग्धि॥
verses.tr: kiṃ bhrātāsad yadanāthaṃ bhavāti kimu svasā yannirṛtirnigacchāt kāmamūtā bahve3tad rapāmi tanvā'me tanvaṃ1 saṃ pipṛgdhi
verses.en: Is he a brother when no help is left her? Is she a sister when Destruction cometh? Forced by my love these many words I utter. Come near, and hold me in thy close embraces,

verses.sa:
न ते नाथं यम्यत्राहमस्मि न ते तनूं तन्वा३ सं पपृच्याम्।
अन्येन मत् प्रमुदः कल्पयस्व न ते भ्राता सुभगे वष्ट्येतत्॥
verses.tr: na te nāthaṃ yamyatrāhamasmi na te tanūṃ tanvā3 saṃ papṛcyām anyena mat pramudaḥ kalpayasva na te bhrātā subhage vaṣṭyetat
verses.en: Iam no help for thee, no refuge, Yami. I will not clasp and press thee to my bosom, 'This is abhorrent to my mind and spirit—a brother on the couch beside a sister.

verses.sa:
न वा उ ते तनूं तन्वा३ सं पपृच्यां पापमाहुर्यः स्वसारं निगच्छात्।
असंयदेतन्मनसो हृदो मे भ्राता स्वसुः शयने यच्छयीय॥
verses.tr: na vā u te tanūṃ tanvā3 saṃ papṛcyāṃ pāpamāhuryaḥ svasāraṃ nigacchāt asaṃyadetanmanaso hṛdo me bhrātā svasuḥ śayane yacchayīya
verses.en: I will not fold mine arms about thy body: they call it sin when one comes near a sister. Not me—prepare thy pleasure with another. Thy. brother seeks not. this from thee, O fair one,

verses.sa:
बतो बतासि यम नैव ते मनो हृदयं चाविदामा।
अन्या किल त्वां कक्ष्येऽव युक्तं परि ष्वजातै लिबुजेव वृक्षम्॥
verses.tr: bato batāsi yama naiva te mano hṛdayaṃ cāvidāmā anyā kila tvāṃ kakṣye'va yuktaṃ pari ṣvajātai libujeva vṛkṣam
verses.en: Alas! thou art indeed a weakling, Yama. We find in thee no trace of heart or spirit, As round a tree the woodbine clings, another will cling about thee girt as with a girdle.

verses.sa:
अन्यमू षु यम्यन्य उ त्वां परि ष्वजातै लिबुजेव वृक्षम्।
तस्य वा त्वं मन इच्छा स वा तवाधा कृणुष्व सविदं सुभद्राम्॥
verses.tr: anyamū ṣu yamyanya u tvāṃ pari ṣvajātai libujeva vṛkṣam tasya vā tvaṃ mana icchā sa vā tavādhā kṛṇuṣva savidaṃ subhadrām
verses.en: Embrace another, Yami. Let some other, even as the woodbine rings a tree, enfold thee. Win thou his heart and let him win thy fancy; so make with him a bond of blest alliance,

verses.sa:
त्रीणि च्छन्दांसि कवयो वि येतिरे पुरुरूपं दर्शतं विश्वचक्षणम्।
आपो वाता ओषधयस्तान्येकस्मिन् भुवन आर्पितानि॥
verses.tr: trīṇi cchandāṃsi kavayo vi yetire pururūpaṃ darśataṃ viśvacakṣaṇam āpo vātā oṣadhayastānyekasmin bhuvana ārpitāni
verses.en: Three hymns the Sages have disposed in order, the many-formed, the fair, the all-beholding, These in one single world are placed and settled—the growing plants, the breezes, and the waters,

verses.sa:
वृषा वृष्णे दुदुहे दोहसा दिवः पयांसि यह्वो अदितेरदाभ्यः ।
विश्वं स वेद वरुणो यथा धिया स यज्ञियो यजति यज्ञियां ऋतून्॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā vṛṣṇe duduhe dohasā divaḥ payāṃsi yahvo aditeradābhyaḥ viśvaṃ sa veda varuṇo yathā dhiyā sa yajñiyo yajati yajñiyāṃ ṛtūn
verses.en: The Bull hath yielded for the Bull the milk of heaven: inviolable is the Son of Aditi. According to his wisdom Varuna knoweth all: he alloweth, the holy, times for sacrifice,

verses.sa:
रपद् गन्धर्वीरप्या च योषणा नदस्य नादे परि पातु नो मनः ।
इष्टस्य मध्ये अदितिर्नि धातु नो भ्राता नो ज्येष्ठः प्रथमो वि वोचति॥
verses.tr: rapad gandharvīrapyā ca yoṣaṇā nadasya nāde pari pātu no manaḥ iṣṭasya madhye aditirni dhātu no bhrātā no jyeṣṭhaḥ prathamo vi vocati
verses.en: Gandharvi spake. May she, the Lady of the Flood amid the river's roaring leave my heart untouched. May Aditi accomplish all that we desire, and may our eldest Brother tell us this as chief,

verses.sa:
सो चिन्नु भद्रा क्षुमती उशस्वत्युषा उवास मनवे स्वऽर्वती ।
यदीमुशन्तमुशतामनु क्रतुमग्निं होतारं विदथाय जीजनन्॥
verses.tr: so cinnu bhadrā kṣumatī uśasvatyuṣā uvāsa manave sva'rvatī yadīmuśantamuśatāmanu kratumagniṃ hotāraṃ vidathāya jījanan
verses.en: Yea, even this blessed Morning, rich in store of food, splendid, with heavenly lustre, hath shone out for man Since they as was the wish of yearning Gods, brought. forth that yearning Agni for the assembly as the Priest,

verses.sa:
अध त्यं द्रप्सं विभ्वं विचक्षणं विराभरदिषिरः श्येनो अध्वरे।
यदी विशो वृणते दस्ममार्या अग्निं होतारमध धीरजायत॥
verses.tr: adha tyaṃ drapsaṃ vibhvaṃ vicakṣaṇaṃ virābharadiṣiraḥ śyeno adhvare yadī viśo vṛṇate dasmamāryā agniṃ hotāramadha dhīrajāyata
verses.en: And the fleet Falcon brought for sacrifice from afar this flowing drop most excellent and passing wise, Then when the Aryan tribes chose as invoking Priest Agni the wonder-worker, and the hymn rose up.

verses.sa:
सदासि रण्वो यवसेव पुष्यते होत्राभिरग्ने मनुषः स्वध्वरः ।
विप्रस्य वा यच्छशमान उक्थ्यो३ वाजं ससवां उपयासि भूरिभिः॥
verses.tr: sadāsi raṇvo yavaseva puṣyate hotrābhiragne manuṣaḥ svadhvaraḥ viprasya vā yacchaśamāna ukthyo3 vājaṃ sasavāṃ upayāsi bhūribhiḥ
verses.en: Still art thou kind to him who feeds thee as with grass, and skilled in sacrifice offers thee holy gifts, When thou having received the sage's strengthening food with lauds, after Ion y toil comest with many more.

verses.sa:
उदीरय पितरा जार आ भगमियक्षति हर्यतो हृत्त इष्यति ।
विवक्ति वह्निः स्वपस्यते मखस्तविष्यते असुरो वेपते मती॥
verses.tr: udīraya pitarā jāra ā bhagamiyakṣati haryato hṛtta iṣyati vivakti vahniḥ svapasyate makhastaviṣyate asuro vepate matī
verses.en: Urge thou thy Parents, as a lover, to delight: the lovely One desires and craves it from his heart. As Priest he calls aloud, as Warrior shows his skill, as Asura tries his strength, and with the hymn is stirred,

verses.sa:
यस्ते अग्ने सुमतिं मर्तो अख्यत् सहसः सूनो अति स प्र शृण्वे ।
इषं दधानो वहमानो अश्वैरा स द्युमां अमवान् भूषति द्यून्॥
verses.tr: yaste agne sumatiṃ marto akhyat sahasaḥ sūno ati sa pra śṛṇve iṣaṃ dadhāno vahamāno aśvairā sa dyumāṃ amavān bhūṣati dyūn
verses.en: Far famed is he, the mortal man, O Agni thou Son of Strength, who hath obtained thy favour. He, gathering power, borne onward by his horses, makes his days lovely in his might and splendour.

verses.sa:
श्रुधी नो अग्ने सदने सधस्थे युक्ष्वा रथममृतस्य द्रवित्नुम्।
आ नो वह रोदसी देवपुत्रे माकिर्देवानामप भूरिह स्याः॥
verses.tr: śrudhī no agne sadane sadhasthe yukṣvā rathamamṛtasya dravitnum ā no vaha rodasī devaputre mākirdevānāmapa bhūriha syāḥ
verses.en: Hear us, O Agni, in the great assembly: harness thy rapid car, the car of Amrit, Bring Heaven and Earth, the Deities? Parents, hither: Stay with us here, nor from the Gods be absent,

verses.sa:
यदग्न एषा समितिर्भवाति देवी देवेषु यजता यजत्र ।
रत्ना च यद् विभजासि स्वधावो भागं नो अत्र वसुमन्तं वीतात्॥
verses.tr: yadagna eṣā samitirbhavāti devī deveṣu yajatā yajatra ratnā ca yad vibhajāsi svadhāvo bhāgaṃ no atra vasumantaṃ vītāt
verses.en: When, holy Agni, the divine assembly, the holy synod mid the Gods, is gathered, And when thou, godlike One, dealest forth treasures, vouchsafe us too our portion of the riches,

verses.sa:
अन्वग्निरुषसामग्रमख्यदन्वहानि प्रथमो जातवेदाः ।
अनु सूर्य उषसो अनु रश्मीननु द्यावापृथिवी आ विवेश॥
verses.tr: anvagniruṣasāmagramakhyadanvahāni prathamo jātavedāḥ anu sūrya uṣaso anu raśmīnanu dyāvāpṛthivī ā viveśa
verses.en: Agni hath looked upon the van of Mornings, and on the days the earliest Jatavedas. After the Dawns, after their rays of brightness, Surya hath entered into earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यग्निरुषसामग्रमख्यत् प्रत्यहानि प्रथमो जातवेदाः ।
प्रति सूर्यस्य पुरुधा च रश्मीन् प्रति द्यावापृथिवी आ ततान॥
verses.tr: pratyagniruṣasāmagramakhyat pratyahāni prathamo jātavedāḥ prati sūryasya purudhā ca raśmīn prati dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatāna
verses.en: Agni hath looked against the van of Mornings, against the days the earliest Jatavedas; In many a place against the beams of Surya, against the heavens and earth hath he extended,

verses.sa:
द्यावा ह क्षामा प्रथमे ऋतेनाभिश्रावे भवतः सत्यवाचा ।
देवो यन्मर्तान् यजथाय कृण्वन्त्सीदद्धोता प्रत्यङ् स्वमसुं यन्॥
verses.tr: dyāvā ha kṣāmā prathame ṛtenābhiśrāve bhavataḥ satyavācā devo yanmartān yajathāya kṛṇvantsīdaddhotā pratyaṅ svamasuṃ yan
verses.en: Heaven and Earth, first by everlasting Order, speakers of truth, are near enough to hear, us, When the God, urging men to worship, sitteth as Priest, assuming all his vital vigour,

verses.sa:
देवो देवान् परिभूरृतेन वहा नो हव्यं प्रथमश्चिकित्वान्।
धूमकेतुः समिधा भाऋजीको मन्द्रो होता नित्यो वाचा यजीयान्॥
verses.tr: devo devān paribhūrṛtena vahā no havyaṃ prathamaścikitvān dhūmaketuḥ samidhā bhāṛjīko mandro hotā nityo vācā yajīyān
verses.en: As God comprising Gods by Law eternal, bear, as the chief who knoweth, our oblation, Smoke-bannered with the fuel, radiant, joyous, better to praise and worship, Priest for ever.

verses.sa:
अर्चामि वां वर्धायापो घृतस्नू द्यावाभूमी शृणुतं रोदसी मे ।
अहा यद् देवा असुनीतिमायन् मध्वा नो अत्र पितरा शिशीताम्॥
verses.tr: arcāmi vāṃ vardhāyāpo ghṛtasnū dyāvābhūmī śṛṇutaṃ rodasī me ahā yad devā asunītimāyan madhvā no atra pitarā śiśītām
verses.en: I praise, your work that ye may make me prosper: hear, Heaven and Earth, twain worlds that drop with fatness! While days and Gods go to the world of spirits, have let the Parents with sweet mead refresh us.

verses.sa:
स्वावृग् देवस्यामृतं यदी गोरतो जातासो धारयन्त उर्वी।
विश्वे देवा अनु तत् ते यजुर्गुर्दुहे यदेनी दिव्यं घृतं वाः॥
verses.tr: svāvṛg devasyāmṛtaṃ yadī gorato jātāso dhārayanta urvī viśve devā anu tat te yajurgurduhe yadenī divyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vāḥ
verses.en: When the Cow's nectar wins the God completely, men here below are heaven's and earth's sustainers. All the Gods come to this thy heavenly Yajus which from the motley Pair milked oil and water

verses.sa:
किं स्विन्नो राजा जगृहे कदस्याति व्रतं चकृमा को वि वेद ।
मित्रस्चिद्धि ष्मा जुहुराणो देवांछ्लोको न यातामपि वाजो अस्ति॥
verses.tr: kiṃ svinno rājā jagṛhe kadasyāti vrataṃ cakṛmā ko vi veda mitrasciddhi ṣmā juhurāṇo devāṃchloko na yātāmapi vājo asti
verses.en: Hath the King seized us? How have we offended against his holy Ordinance? Who knoweth? For even Mitra mid the Gods is angry. There are both song and wealth for those who come not.

verses.sa:
दुर्मन्त्वत्रामृतस्य नाम सलक्ष्मा यद् विषुरूपा भवाति ।
यमस्य यो मनवते सुमन्त्वग्ने तमृष्व पाह्यप्रयुच्छन्॥
verses.tr: durmantvatrāmṛtasya nāma salakṣmā yad viṣurūpā bhavāti yamasya yo manavate sumantvagne tamṛṣva pāhyaprayucchan
verses.en: 'Tis hard to understand the Immortal's nature, where she who is akin becomes a stranger. Guard ceaselessly, great Agni, him who ponders Yama's name easy to be comprehended,

verses.sa:
यस्मिन् देवा विदथे मादयन्ते विवस्वतः सदने धारयन्ते ।
सूर्ये ज्योतिरदधुर्मास्य१क्तून् परि द्योतनिं चरतो अजस्रा॥
verses.tr: yasmin devā vidathe mādayante vivasvataḥ sadane dhārayante sūrye jyotiradadhurmāsya1ktūn pari dyotaniṃ carato ajasrā
verses.en: They in the synod where the Gods rejoice them, where they are seated in Vivasvan's dwelling, Have given the Moon his beams, the Sun his splendour: the two unweariedly maintain vheir brightness,

verses.sa:
यस्मिन् देवा मन्मनि संचरन्त्यपीच्ये३ न वयमस्य विद्म ।
मित्रो नो अत्रादितिरनागान्त्सविता देवो वरुणाय वोचत्॥
verses.tr: yasmin devā manmani saṃcarantyapīcye3 na vayamasya vidma mitro no atrāditiranāgāntsavitā devo varuṇāya vocat
verses.en: The counsel which the Gods meet to consider, their secret plan, of that we have no knowledge. There let God Savitar, Aditi, and Mitra proclaim to Varuna that we are sinless.

verses.sa:
सखाय आ शिषामहे ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे ।
स्तुष ऊ षु नृतमाय धृष्णवे॥
verses.tr: sakhāya ā śiṣāmahe brahmendrāya vajriṇe stuṣa ū ṣu nṛtamāya dhṛṣṇave
verses.en: Companions, let us learn a prayer to Indra whom the thunder arms, To glorify your bold and most heroic Friend.

verses.sa:
शवसा ह्यसि श्रुतो वृत्रहत्येन वृत्रहा।
मघैर्मघोनो अति शूर दाशसि॥
verses.tr: śavasā hyasi śruto vṛtrahatyena vṛtrahā maghairmaghono ati śūra dāśasi
verses.en: For thou by slaying Vritra art the Vritra-slayer, famed for might. Thou, Hero, in rich gifts surpassest wealthy chiefs.

verses.sa:
स्तेगो न क्षामत्येषि पृथिवीं मही नो वाता इह वान्तु भूमौ ।
मित्रो नो अत्र वरुणो युजमानो अग्निर्वने न व्यसृष्ट शोकम्॥
verses.tr: stego na kṣāmatyeṣi pṛthivīṃ mahī no vātā iha vāntu bhūmau mitro no atra varuṇo yujamāno agnirvane na vyasṛṣṭa śokam
verses.en: O'er the broad land thou goest like a Stega: here on vast earth let breezes blow upon us. Here hath our dear Friend Varuna, united, like Agni in the wood, shot forth his splendour.

verses.sa:
स्तुहि श्रुतं गर्तसदं जनानां राजानं भीममुपहत्नुमुग्रम्।
मृडा जरित्रे रुद्र स्तवानो अन्यमस्मत् ते नि वपन्तु सेन्यम्॥
verses.tr: stuhi śrutaṃ gartasadaṃ janānāṃ rājānaṃ bhīmamupahatnumugram mṛḍā jaritre rudra stavāno anyamasmat te ni vapantu senyam
verses.en: Sing praise to him the chariot-borne, the famous, Sovran of men, the dread and strong destroyer, O Rudra, praised, be gracious to the singer: let thy darts spare us and smite down another.

verses.sa:
सरस्वतीं देवयन्तो हवन्ते सरस्वतीमध्वरे तायमाने ।
सरस्वतीं सुकृतो हवन्ते सरस्वती दाशुषे वार्यं दात्॥
verses.tr: sarasvatīṃ devayanto havante sarasvatīmadhvare tāyamāne sarasvatīṃ sukṛto havante sarasvatī dāśuṣe vāryaṃ dāt
verses.en: The pious call Sarasvati, they worship Sarasvati while sacrifice proceedeth. The virtuous call Sarasvati to hear them, Sarasvati send bliss to him who giveth!

verses.sa:
सरस्वतीं पितरो हवन्ते दक्षिणा यज्ञमभिनक्षमाणाः ।
आसद्यास्मिन् बर्हिषि मादयध्वमनमीवा इष आ धेह्यस्मे॥
verses.tr: sarasvatīṃ pitaro havante dakṣiṇā yajñamabhinakṣamāṇāḥ āsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayadhvamanamīvā iṣa ā dhehyasme
verses.en: Sarasvati is called on by the Fathers who come right. forward to our solemn worship. Seated upon this sacred grass rejoice you. Give thou us strengthening food that brings no sickness.

verses.sa:
सरस्वति या सरथं ययाथोक्थैः स्वधाभिर्देवि पितृभिर्मदन्ती ।
सहस्रार्घमिडो अत्र भागं रायस्पोषं यजमानाय धेहि॥
verses.tr: sarasvati yā sarathaṃ yayāthokthaiḥ svadhābhirdevi pitṛbhirmadantī sahasrārghamiḍo atra bhāgaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamānāya dhehi
verses.en: Sarasvati, who comest with the Fathers, joying in hymns, O Goddess, and oblations, Give plenteous wealth to this the sacrificer, a portion, worth a thousand, of refreshment.

verses.sa:
उदीरतामवर उत् परास उन्मध्यमाः पितरः सोम्यासः ।
असुं य ईयुरवृका ऋतज्ञास्ते नोऽवन्तु पितरो हवेषु॥
verses.tr: udīratāmavara ut parāsa unmadhyamāḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ asuṃ ya īyuravṛkā ṛtajñāste no'vantu pitaro haveṣu
verses.en: May they ascend, the lowest, highest, midmost, the Fathers who deserve a share of Soma, May they who have attained to life, the Fathers, righteous and gentle, aid us when we call them,

verses.sa:
आहं पितृन्त्सुविदत्रां अवित्सि नपातं च विक्रमणं च विष्णोः ।
बर्हिषदो ये स्वधया सुतस्य भजन्त पित्वस्त इहागमिष्ठाः॥
verses.tr: āhaṃ pitṛntsuvidatrāṃ avitsi napātaṃ ca vikramaṇaṃ ca viṣṇoḥ barhiṣado ye svadhayā sutasya bhajanta pitvasta ihāgamiṣṭhāḥ
verses.en: I have attained the gracious-minded Fathers, I have gained son and progeny from Vishnu, They who enjoy pressed juices with oblation, seated on sacred grass, come oftenest hither.

verses.sa:
इदं पितृभ्यो नमो अस्त्वद्य ये पूर्वासो ये अपरास ईयुः ।
ये पार्थिवे रजस्या निषक्ता ये वा नूनं सुवृजनासु दिक्षु॥
verses.tr: idaṃ pitṛbhyo namo astvadya ye pūrvāso ye aparāsa īyuḥ ye pārthive rajasyā niṣaktā ye vā nūnaṃ suvṛjanāsu dikṣu
verses.en: Now be this homage offered to the Fathers, to those who passed of old and those who followed, Those who have rested in the earthly region, and those who dwell among the happy races.

verses.sa:
मातली कव्यैर्यमो अङ्गिरोभिर्बृहस्पतिर्ऋक्वभिर्वावृधानः ।
यांश्च देवा वावृधुर्ये च देवांस्ते नोऽवन्तु पितरो हवेषु॥
verses.tr: mātalī kavyairyamo aṅgirobhirbṛhaspatirṛkvabhirvāvṛdhānaḥ yāṃśca devā vāvṛdhurye ca devāṃste no'vantu pitaro haveṣu
verses.en: Matali prospers there with Kavyas, Yama with Angiras' sons, Brihaspati with singers. Exalters of the Gods, by Gods exalted, aid us those Fathers in our invocations!

verses.sa:
स्वादुष्किलायं मधुमां उतायं तीव्रः किलायं रसवां उतायम्।
उतोन्व१स्य पपिवांसमिन्द्रं न कश्चन सहत आहवेषु॥
verses.tr: svāduṣkilāyaṃ madhumāṃ utāyaṃ tīvraḥ kilāyaṃ rasavāṃ utāyam utonva1sya papivāṃsamindraṃ na kaścana sahata āhaveṣu
verses.en: Ye, this is good to taste and full of sweetness, verily it is strong and rich in flavour. No one may conquer Indra in the battle when he hath drunken of the draught we offer,

verses.sa:
परेयिवांसं प्रवतो महीरिति बहुभ्यः पन्थामनुपस्पशानम्।
वैवस्वतं संगमनं जनानां यमं राजानं हविषा सपर्यत॥
verses.tr: pareyivāṃsaṃ pravato mahīriti bahubhyaḥ panthāmanupaspaśānam vaivasvataṃ saṃgamanaṃ janānāṃ yamaṃ rājānaṃ haviṣā saparyata
verses.en: Honour the King with your oblations, Yama, Vivasvan's son, who gathers men together, Even him who travelled o'er the mighty rivers, who searches out and shows the path to many.

verses.sa:
यमो नो गातुं प्रथमो विवेद नैषा गव्यूतिरपभर्तवा उ ।
यत्रा नः पूर्वे पितरः परेता एना जज्ञानाः पथ्या३ अनु स्वाः॥
verses.tr: yamo no gātuṃ prathamo viveda naiṣā gavyūtirapabhartavā u yatrā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ paretā enā jajñānāḥ pathyā3 anu svāḥ
verses.en: Yama first found for us the road to travel: this pasture never can be taken from us, Men born on earth tread their own paths that lead them whither our ancient Fathers have departed,

verses.sa:
बर्हिषदः पितर ऊत्य१र्वागिमा वो हव्या चकृमा जुषध्वम्।
त आ गतावसा शंतमेनाधा नः शं योररपो दधात॥
verses.tr: barhiṣadaḥ pitara ūtya1rvāgimā vo havyā cakṛmā juṣadhvam ta ā gatāvasā śaṃtamenādhā naḥ śaṃ yorarapo dadhāta
verses.en: Fathers who sit on sacred grass, come, help us: these offerings have we made for you; accept them. So come to us with most auspicious favour: bestow on us unfailing health and plenty.

verses.sa:
आच्या जानु दक्षिणतो निषद्येदं नो हविरभि गृणन्तु विश्वे ।
मा हिंसिष्ट पितरः केन चिन्नो यद् व आगः पुरुषता कराम॥
verses.tr: ācyā jānu dakṣiṇato niṣadyedaṃ no havirabhi gṛṇantu viśve mā hiṃsiṣṭa pitaraḥ kena cinno yad va āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma
verses.en: Bowing their bended knees and seated southward let all accept this sacrifice with favour, Punish us not for any sin, O Fathers, which we through human frailty have committed,

verses.sa:
त्वष्टा दुहित्रे वहतुं कृणोति तेनेदं विश्वं भुवनं समेति ।
यमस्य माता पर्युह्यमाना महो जाया विवस्वतो ननाश॥
verses.tr: tvaṣṭā duhitre vahatuṃ kṛṇoti tenedaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ sameti yamasya mātā paryuhyamānā maho jāyā vivasvato nanāśa
verses.en: Tvashtar prepares the bridal for his daughter: therefore the whole of this our world assembles, But Yama's mother, spouse of great Vivasvan, vanished as she was carried to her dwelling.

verses.sa:
प्रेहि प्रेहि पथिभिः पूर्याणैर्येना ते पूर्वे पितरः परेताः ।
उभा राजानौ स्वधया मदन्तौ यमं पश्यासि वरुणं च देवम्॥
verses.tr: prehi prehi pathibhiḥ pūryāṇairyenā te pūrve pitaraḥ paretāḥ ubhā rājānau svadhayā madantau yamaṃ paśyāsi varuṇaṃ ca devam
verses.en: Go forth, go forth upon the homeward pathways ' whither our sires of old have gone before us, Then shalt thou look on both the Kings enjoying 'their sacred food, God Varuna and Yama,

verses.sa:
अपेत वीऽत वि च सर्पतातोऽस्मा एतं पितरो लोकमक्रन्।
अहोभिरद्भिरक्तुभिर्व्यऽक्तं यमो ददात्यवसानमस्मै॥
verses.tr: apeta vī'ta vi ca sarpatāto'smā etaṃ pitaro lokamakran ahobhiradbhiraktubhirvya'ktaṃ yamo dadātyavasānamasmai
verses.en: Go hence, depart ye, fly in all directions. This world for him the Fathers have provided. Yama bestow upon this man a dwelling adorned with days and beams of light and waters.

verses.sa:
उशन्तस्त्वेधीमह्युशन्तः समिधीमहि ।
उशन्नुशत आ वह पितॄन् हविषे अत्तवे॥
verses.tr: uśantastvedhīmahyuśantaḥ samidhīmahi uśannuśata ā vaha pitṝn haviṣe attave
verses.en: We set thee down with yearning, and with yearning we enkindle thee, Yearning, bring yearning Fathers nigh to eat the food of sacrifice,

verses.sa:
द्युमन्तस्त्वेधीमहि द्युमन्तः समिधीमहि ।
द्युमान् द्युमत आ वह पितॄन् हविषे अत्तवे॥
verses.tr: dyumantastvedhīmahi dyumantaḥ samidhīmahi dyumān dyumata ā vaha pitṝn haviṣe attave
verses.en: We, splendid men, deposit thee, we, splendid men, enkindle thee, Splendid, bring splendid Fathers nigh to eat the sacrificial food,

verses.sa:
अङ्गिरसो नः पितरो नवग्वा अथर्वाणो भृगवः सोम्यासः ।
तेषां वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियानामपि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम॥
verses.tr: aṅgiraso naḥ pitaro navagvā atharvāṇo bhṛgavaḥ somyāsaḥ teṣāṃ vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyānāmapi bhadre saumanase syāma
verses.en: Our Fathers are Angirases, Navagvas, Atharvans, Bhrigus, who deserve the Soma, May these, the holy, look on us with favour; may we enjoy their gracious loving-kindness.

verses.sa:
अङ्गिरोभिर्यज्ञियैरा गहीह यम वैरूपैरिह मादयस्व ।
विवस्वन्तं हुवे यः पिता तेऽस्मिन् बर्हिष्या निषद्य॥
verses.tr: aṅgirobhiryajñiyairā gahīha yama vairūpairiha mādayasva vivasvantaṃ huve yaḥ pitā te'smin barhiṣyā niṣadya
verses.en: Come, Yama, with Angirases, the holy; rejoice thee here with children of Virupa, Seated on sacred grass at this oblation: I call Vivasvan too, thy father, hither.

verses.sa:
इमं यम प्रस्तरमा हि रोहाङ्गिरोभिः पितृभिः संविदानः ।
आ त्वा मन्त्राः कविशस्ता वहन्त्वेना राजन् हविषो मादयस्व॥
verses.tr: imaṃ yama prastaramā hi rohāṅgirobhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ ā tvā mantrāḥ kaviśastā vahantvenā rājan haviṣo mādayasva
verses.en: Come, seat thee on this bed of grass, O Yama, accordant with Angirases and Fathers, Let texts recited by the sages bring thee, O King, let this oblation make thee joyful.

verses.sa:
इत एत उदारुहन् दिवस्पृष्ठान्वारुहन्।
प्र भूर्जयो यथा पथा द्यामङ्गिरसो ययुः॥
verses.tr: ita eta udāruhan divaspṛṣṭhānvāruhan pra bhūrjayo yathā pathā dyāmaṅgiraso yayuḥ
verses.en: He hath gone hence and risen on high mounting heaven's ridges by that path Whereon the sons of Angiras, the conquerors of earth, went up.

sections.label: A funeral hymn, taken mainly from the Rigveda
sections.name: Book 18, hymn 2

verses.sa:
यमाय सोमः पवते यमाय क्रियते हविः ।
यमं ह यज्ञो गच्छत्यग्निदूतो अरंकृतः॥
verses.tr: yamāya somaḥ pavate yamāya kriyate haviḥ yamaṃ ha yajño gacchatyagnidūto araṃkṛtaḥ
verses.en: For Yama Soma juice flows clear, to Yama is oblation paid. To Yama sacrifice prepared, and heralded by Agni, goes.

verses.sa:
यमाय मधुमत्तमं जुहोता प्र च तिष्ठत ।
इदं नम ऋषिभ्यः पूर्वजेभ्यः पूर्वेभ्यः पथिकृद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: yamāya madhumattamaṃ juhotā pra ca tiṣṭhata idaṃ nama ṛṣibhyaḥ pūrvajebhyaḥ pūrvebhyaḥ pathikṛdbhyaḥ
verses.en: Offer to Yama sacrifice most sweet in savour and draw near. Bow down before the Rishis of the olden time, the ancient ones who made the path.

verses.sa:
यमाय घृतवत् पयो राज्ञे हविर्जुहोतन ।
स नो जीवेष्वा यमेद् दीर्घमायुः प्र जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yamāya ghṛtavat payo rājñe havirjuhotana sa no jīveṣvā yamed dīrghamāyuḥ pra jīvase
verses.en: Offer to Yama, to the King, butter and milk in sacrifice. So may he grant that we may live long days of life mid living men, l

verses.sa:
मैनमग्ने वि दहो माभि शूशुचो मास्य त्वचं चिक्षिपो मा शरीरम्।
शृतं यदा करसि जातवेदोऽथेमेनं प्र हिणुतात् पितॄँरुप॥
verses.tr: mainamagne vi daho mābhi śūśuco māsya tvacaṃ cikṣipo mā śarīram śṛtaṃ yadā karasi jātavedo'themenaṃ pra hiṇutāt pitṝṃrupa
verses.en: Burn him not up, nor quite consume him, Agni, Let not his body or his skin be scattered. O Jatavedas, when thou hast matured him, then send him on his way unto the Fathers.

verses.sa:
यदा शृतं कृणवो जातवेदोऽथेममेनं परि दत्तात् पितृभ्यः ।
यदो गच्छात्यसुनीतिमेतामथ देवानां वशनीर्भवाति॥
verses.tr: yadā śṛtaṃ kṛṇavo jātavedo'themamenaṃ pari dattāt pitṛbhyaḥ yado gacchātyasunītimetāmatha devānāṃ vaśanīrbhavāti
verses.en: When thou hast made him ready, Jatavedas, then do thou give him over to the Fathers. When he attains unto the life that waits him he will obey the Deities commandment,

verses.sa:
त्रिकद्रुकेभिः पवते षडुर्वीरेकमिद् बृहत्।
त्रिष्टुब् गायत्री छन्दांसि सर्वा ता यम आर्पिता॥
verses.tr: trikadrukebhiḥ pavate ṣaḍurvīrekamid bṛhat triṣṭub gāyatrī chandāṃsi sarvā tā yama ārpitā
verses.en: With the three jars Brihat alone makes pure the six wide-spreading realms, The Gayatri, the Trishtup, all metres in Yama are contained, s

verses.sa:
सूर्यं चक्षुषा गच्छ वातमात्मना दिवं च गच्छ पृथिवीं च धर्मभिः ।
अपो वा गच्छ यदि तत्र ते हितमोषधीषु प्रति तिष्ठा शरीरैः॥
verses.tr: sūryaṃ cakṣuṣā gaccha vātamātmanā divaṃ ca gaccha pṛthivīṃ ca dharmabhiḥ apo vā gaccha yadi tatra te hitamoṣadhīṣu prati tiṣṭhā śarīraiḥ
verses.en: The Sun receive thine eye, the wind thy spirit; go, as thy merit is, to earth or heaven. Go, if it be thy lot, unto the waters; go, make thy home in plants with all thy members.

verses.sa:
अजो भागस्तपसस्तं तपस्व तं ते शोचिस्तपतु तं ते अर्चिः ।
यास्ते शिवास्तन्वोऽ जातवेदस्ताभिर्वहैनं सुकृतामु लोकम्॥
verses.tr: ajo bhāgastapasastaṃ tapasva taṃ te śocistapatu taṃ te arciḥ yāste śivāstanvo' jātavedastābhirvahainaṃ sukṛtāmu lokam
verses.en: Thy portion is the goat: with heat consume him: let thy fierce flame, thy glowing splendour, burn him, With thine auspicious forms, O Jatavedas, bear this man to the region of the pious.

verses.sa:
यास्ते शोचयो रंहयो जातवेदो याभिरापृणासि दिवमन्तरिक्षम्।
अजं यन्तमनु ताः समृण्वतामथेतराभिः शिवतमाभिः शृतं कृधि॥
verses.tr: yāste śocayo raṃhayo jātavedo yābhirāpṛṇāsi divamantarikṣam ajaṃ yantamanu tāḥ samṛṇvatāmathetarābhiḥ śivatamābhiḥ śṛtaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: Let all thy rapid flames, O Jatavedas, wherewith thou fillest heaven and earth's mid-region, Follow the goat as he goes on, united: then with the others, most auspicious, aid us,

verses.sa:
अव सृज पुनरग्ने पितृभ्यो यस्त आहुतश्चरति स्वधावान्।
आयुर्वसान उप यातु शेषः सं गच्छतां तन्वा सुवर्चाः॥
verses.tr: ava sṛja punaragne pitṛbhyo yasta āhutaścarati svadhāvān āyurvasāna upa yātu śeṣaḥ saṃ gacchatāṃ tanvā suvarcāḥ
verses.en: Away, O Agni, to the Fathers send him who, offered in thee, goes with our oblations. Wearing new life let him approach his offspring, and splendid, be invested with a body Taken from R. V. X. 16.3. The Sun receive thine eye, the wind thy spirit: let "like return to like. Of. A. V. V. VIII.

verses.sa:
अति द्रव श्वानौ सारमेयौ चतुरक्षौ शबलौ साधुना पथा।
अधा पितॄन्त्सुविदत्रां अपीहि यमेन ये सधमादं मदन्ति॥
verses.tr: ati drava śvānau sārameyau caturakṣau śabalau sādhunā pathā adhā pitṝntsuvidatrāṃ apīhi yamena ye sadhamādaṃ madanti
verses.en: Run and outspeed the two dogs, Sarama's offspring, brindled, four-eyed, upon thy happy pathway. Draw nigh then to the gracious-minded Fathers who take their pleasure in the feast with Yama.

verses.sa: यौ ते श्वानौ यम रक्षितारौ चतुरक्षौ पथिषदी नृचक्षसा । ताभ्यां राजन् परि धेह्येनं स्वस्त्यऽस्मा अनमीवं च धेहि॥
verses.tr: yau te śvānau yama rakṣitārau caturakṣau pathiṣadī nṛcakṣasā tābhyāṃ rājan pari dhehyenaṃ svastya'smā anamīvaṃ ca dhehi
verses.en: And those two dogs of thine, Yama, the watchers, four-eyed who look on men and guard the path Entrust this man, O King, to their protection, and with prosperity and health endow him.

verses.sa:
उरूणसावसुतृपावुदुम्बलौ यमस्य दूतौ चरतो जनां अनु ।
तावस्मभ्यं दृशये सूर्याय पुनर्दातामसुमद्येह भद्रम्॥
verses.tr: urūṇasāvasutṛpāvudumbalau yamasya dūtau carato janāṃ anu tāvasmabhyaṃ dṛśaye sūryāya punardātāmasumadyeha bhadram
verses.en: Dark-hued, insatiate, with distended nostrils, Yama's two envoys roam among the people. May they restore to us a fair existence here and to-day that we may see the sunlight.

verses.sa:
सोम एकेभ्यः पवते घृतमेक उपासते ।
येभ्यो मधु प्रधावति तांश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात्॥
verses.tr: soma ekebhyaḥ pavate ghṛtameka upāsate yebhyo madhu pradhāvati tāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt
verses.en: For some the Soma juice runs clear, some sit by sacrificial oil. To those for whom the meath flows forth, even to those let him depart,

verses.sa:
ये चित् पूर्व ऋतसाता ऋतजाता ऋतावृधः ।
ऋषीन् तपस्वतो यम तपोजां अपि गच्छतात्॥
verses.tr: ye cit pūrva ṛtasātā ṛtajātā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ ṛṣīn tapasvato yama tapojāṃ api gacchatāt
verses.en: Let him, O Yama, go to those Rishis austere, of Fervour born, i First followers of Law, the sons of Law, upholders of the Law,

verses.sa:
तपसा ये अनाधृष्यास्तपसा ये स्वऽर्ययुः ।
तपो ये चक्रिरे महस्तांश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात्॥
verses.tr: tapasā ye anādhṛṣyāstapasā ye sva'ryayuḥ tapo ye cakrire mahastāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt
verses.en: Invincible through Fervour, they who by their Fervour went to heaven. Who practised great austerity,—even to those let him depart.

verses.sa:
ये युध्यन्ते प्रधनेषु शूरासो ये तनूत्यजः ।
ये वा सहस्रदक्षिणास्तांश्चिदेवापि गच्छतात्॥
verses.tr: ye yudhyante pradhaneṣu śūrāso ye tanūtyajaḥ ye vā sahasradakṣiṇāstāṃścidevāpi gacchatāt
verses.en: The herose who contend in war and boldly cast their lives away, Or who give guerdon thousandfold,—even to those let him depart.

verses.sa:
सहस्रणीथाः कवयो ये गोपायन्ति सूर्यम्।
ऋषीन् तपस्वतो यम तपोजां अपि गच्छतात्॥
verses.tr: sahasraṇīthāḥ kavayo ye gopāyanti sūryam ṛṣīn tapasvato yama tapojāṃ api gacchatāt
verses.en: Let him, O Yama, goto those Rishis austere, of Fervour born, Skilled in a thousand ways and means, the sages who protect the Sun.

verses.sa:
स्योनास्मै भव पृथिव्यनृक्षरा निवेशनी ।
यच्छास्मै शर्म सप्रथाः॥
verses.tr: syonāsmai bhava pṛthivyanṛkṣarā niveśanī yacchāsmai śarma saprathāḥ
verses.en: Be pleasant unto him, O Earth, thornless and lulling him to rest. Vouchsafe him shelter broad and sure,

verses.sa:
असंबाधे पृथिव्या उरौ लोके नि धीयस्व ।
स्वधा याश्चकृषे जीवन् तास्ते सन्तु मधुश्चुतः॥
verses.tr: asaṃbādhe pṛthivyā urau loke ni dhīyasva svadhā yāścakṛṣe jīvan tāste santu madhuścutaḥ
verses.en: In the free amplitude of earth take roomy space to lodge thee in, Let all oblations which in life thou paidest drop thee honey now.

verses.sa:
ह्वयामि ते मनसा मन इहेमान् गृहाँ उप जुजुषाण एहि ।
सं गच्छस्व पितृभिः सं यमेन स्योनास्त्वा वाता उप वान्तु शग्माः॥
verses.tr: hvayāmi te manasā mana ihemān gṛhāṃ upa jujuṣāṇa ehi saṃ gacchasva pitṛbhiḥ saṃ yamena syonāstvā vātā upa vāntu śagmāḥ
verses.en: Hither I call thy spirit with my spirit, Come thou, delighted, to these dwelling-places. Unite thee with the Fathers and with Yama: strong and delicious be the winds that fan thee,

verses.sa:
उत् त्वा वहन्तु मरुत उदवाहा उदप्रुतः ।
अजेन कृण्वन्तः शीतं वर्षेणोक्षन्तु बालिति॥
verses.tr: ut tvā vahantu maruta udavāhā udaprutaḥ ajena kṛṇvantaḥ śītaṃ varṣeṇokṣantu bāliti
verses.en: Floating in water, bringing streams, let Maruts carry thee aloft, And causing coolness by their rush sprinkle thee with their falling rain, A

verses.sa:
उदह्वमायुरायुषे क्रत्वे दक्षाय जीवसे ।
स्वान् गच्छतु ते मनो अधा पितॄंरुप द्रव॥
verses.tr: udahvamāyurāyuṣe kratve dakṣāya jīvase svān gacchatu te mano adhā pitṝṃrupa drava
verses.en: I have recalled thy life to life, to being, power, and energy. Let thy soul go unto its own: so to the Fathers hasten thou,

verses.sa:
मा ते मनो मासोर्माङ्गानां मा रसस्य ते ।
मा ते हास्त तन्वः१ किं चनेह॥
verses.tr: mā te mano māsormāṅgānāṃ mā rasasya te mā te hāsta tanvaḥ1 kiṃ caneha
verses.en: Let not thy soul be left behind: here let not aught of thee remain, Of spirit, body, members, sap.

verses.sa:
मा त्वा वृक्षः सं बाधिष्ट मा देवी पृथिवी मही।
लोकं पितृषु वित्त्वैधस्व यमराजसु॥
verses.tr: mā tvā vṛkṣaḥ saṃ bādhiṣṭa mā devī pṛthivī mahī lokaṃ pitṛṣu vittvaidhasva yamarājasu
verses.en: Let not a tree oppress thee, nor Earth the great Goddess weigh thee down. Among the Fathers find thy home, and thrive mid those whom Yama rules.

verses.sa:
यत् ते अङ्गमतिहितं पराचैरपानः प्राणो य उ वा ते परेतः ।
तत् ते संगत्य पितरः सनीडा घासाद् घासं पुनरा वेशयन्तु॥
verses.tr: yat te aṅgamatihitaṃ parācairapānaḥ prāṇo ya u vā te paretaḥ tat te saṃgatya pitaraḥ sanīḍā ghāsād ghāsaṃ punarā veśayantu
verses.en: Each parted member, severed from thy body, thy vital breaths that in the wind have vanished, With all of these, piece after piece, shall Fathers who dwell together meet and reunite thee.

verses.sa:
अपेमं जीवा अरुधन् गृहेभ्यस्तं निर्वहत परि ग्रामादितः ।
मृत्युर्यमस्यासीद् दूतः प्रचेता असून् पितृभ्यो गमयां चकार॥
verses.tr: apemaṃ jīvā arudhan gṛhebhyastaṃ nirvahata pari grāmāditaḥ mṛtyuryamasyāsīd dūtaḥ pracetā asūn pitṛbhyo gamayāṃ cakāra
verses.en: Him have the living banished from their houses: remove him to a distance from the hamlet, Yama's observant messenger was Mrityu: he hath despatched men's lives unto the Fathers.

verses.sa:
ये दस्यवः पितृषु प्रविष्टा ज्ञातिमुखा अहुतादश्चरन्ति ।
परापुरो निपुरो ये भरन्त्यग्निष्टानस्मात् प्र धमाति यज्ञात्॥
verses.tr: ye dasyavaḥ pitṛṣu praviṣṭā jñātimukhā ahutādaścaranti parāpuro nipuro ye bharantyagniṣṭānasmāt pra dhamāti yajñāt
verses.en: Those Dasyus who, not eating our oblations, come with friends' faces mingled with the Fathers, Those who wear gross, those who wear subtile bodies,—from this our sacrifice let Agni blast them.

verses.sa:
सं विशन्त्विह पितरः स्वा नः स्योनं कृण्वन्तः प्रतिरन्त आयुः ।
तेभ्यः शकेम हविषा नक्षमाणा ज्योग् जीवन्तः शरदः पुरूचीः॥
verses.tr: saṃ viśantviha pitaraḥ svā naḥ syonaṃ kṛṇvantaḥ pratiranta āyuḥ tebhyaḥ śakema haviṣā nakṣamāṇā jyog jīvantaḥ śaradaḥ purūcīḥ
verses.en: Bringing delight, prolonging our existence, here let our own, the Fathers, dwell together, Coming with sacrifice may we assist them, living long lives through many autumn seasons.

verses.sa:
यां ते धेनुं निपृणामि यमु ते क्षीर ओदनम्।
तेना जनस्यासो भर्ता योऽत्रासदजीवनः॥
verses.tr: yāṃ te dhenuṃ nipṛṇāmi yamu te kṣīra odanam tenā janasyāso bhartā yo'trāsadajīvanaḥ
verses.en: Now by this cow I bring thee, by the boiled rice set in milk for thee, Be the supporter of the folk left here without a livelihood.

verses.sa:
अश्वावतीं प्र तर या सुशेवार्क्षाकं वा प्रतरं नवीयः ।
यस्त्वा जघान वध्यः सो अस्तु मा सो अन्यद् विदत भागधेयम्॥
verses.tr: aśvāvatīṃ pra tara yā suśevārkṣākaṃ vā prataraṃ navīyaḥ yastvā jaghāna vadhyaḥ so astu mā so anyad vidata bhāgadheyam
verses.en: Prolong the pleasant Dawn enriched with horses—or bearing us anew beyond the darkness, Adjudged to die be he, the man who slew thee: this portion let him find, and not another.

verses.sa:
यमः परोऽवरो विवस्वान् ततः परं नाति पश्यामि किं चन।
यमे अध्वरो अधि मे निविष्टो भुवो विवस्वानन्वाततान॥
verses.tr: yamaḥ paro'varo vivasvān tataḥ paraṃ nāti paśyāmi kiṃ cana yame adhvaro adhi me niviṣṭo bhuvo vivasvānanvātatāna
verses.en: Yama is higher and Vivasvan lower: nothing whatever do I see above him, This sacrifice of mine is based on Yama. Vivasvan spread the atmosphere about us.

verses.sa:
अपागूहन्नमृतां मर्त्येभ्यः कृत्वा सवर्णामदधुर्विवस्वते ।
उताश्विनावभरद् यत् तदासीदजहादु द्वा मिथुना सरण्यूः॥
verses.tr: apāgūhannamṛtāṃ martyebhyaḥ kṛtvā savarṇāmadadhurvivasvate utāśvināvabharad yat tadāsīdajahādu dvā mithunā saraṇyūḥ
verses.en: From mortal men they hid the immortal Lady, made one like her and gave her to Vivasvan, Saranyu brought to him the Asvin brothers, and then deserted both twinned pairs of children.

verses.sa:
ये निखाता ये परोप्ता ये दग्धा ये चोद्धिताः ।
सर्वांस्तानग्न आ वह पितॄन् हविषे अत्तवे॥
verses.tr: ye nikhātā ye paroptā ye dagdhā ye coddhitāḥ sarvāṃstānagna ā vaha pitṝn haviṣe attave
verses.en: Bring thou the Fathers one and all, Agni, to eat the sacrifice, The buried, and the cast away, those burnt with fire, and those exposed,

verses.sa:
ये अग्निदग्धा ये अनग्निदग्धा मध्ये दिवः स्वधया मादयन्ते ।
त्वं तान् वेत्थ यदि ते जातवेदः स्वधया यज्ञं स्वधितिं जुषन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: ye agnidagdhā ye anagnidagdhā madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayante tvaṃ tān vettha yadi te jātavedaḥ svadhayā yajñaṃ svadhitiṃ juṣantām
verses.en: Those, whether flames have burnt or not consumed them, who in the midst of heaven enjoy oblations—Let them, when thou dost know them, Jatavedas, accept with sacred food the axe and worship,

verses.sa:
शं तप माति तपो अग्ने मा तन्वं१ तपः ।
वणेषु शुष्मो अस्तु ते पृथिव्यामस्तु यद्धरः॥
verses.tr: śaṃ tapa māti tapo agne mā tanvaṃ1 tapaḥ vaṇeṣu śuṣmo astu te pṛthivyāmastu yaddharaḥ
verses.en: Burn gently, Agni, burn not up the body with too fervent heat, Let all thy force and fury be expended on the woods and earth,

verses.sa:
ददाम्यस्मा अवसानमेतद् य एष आगन् मम चेदभूदिह।
यमश्चिकित्वान् प्रत्येतदाह ममैष राय उप तिष्ठतामिह॥
verses.tr: dadāmyasmā avasānametad ya eṣa āgan mama cedabhūdiha yamaścikitvān pratyetadāha mamaiṣa rāya upa tiṣṭhatāmiha
verses.en: I give this place to him who hath come hither and now is mine, to be a home to rest in: This was the thought of Yama when he answered: This man is mine, Let him come here to riches.

verses.sa:
इमां मात्रां मिमीमहे यथापरं न मासातै ।
शते शरत्सु नो पुरा॥
verses.tr: imāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai śate śaratsu no purā
verses.en: This date we settle once for all, that it may ne'er be fixt again. A hundred autumns; not before,

verses.sa:
प्रेमां मात्रां मिमीमहे यथापरं न मासातै ।
शते शरत्सु नो पुरा॥
verses.tr: premāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai śate śaratsu no purā
verses.en: This date we order, etc.

verses.sa:
अपेमां मात्रां मिमीमहे यथापरं न मासातै ।
शते शरत्सु नो पुरा॥
verses.tr: apemāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai śate śaratsu no purā
verses.en: This date we limit, etc.

verses.sa:
वी३मां मात्रां मिमीमहे यथापरं न मासातै ।
शते शरत्सु नो पुरा॥
verses.tr: vī3māṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai śate śaratsu no purā
verses.en: This date we measure, etc,

verses.sa:
निरिमां मात्रां मिमीमहे यथापरं न मासातै ।
शते शरत्सु नो पुरा॥
verses.tr: nirimāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai śate śaratsu no purā
verses.en: This date we mete out, etc,

verses.sa:
उदिमां मात्रां मिमीमहे यथापरं न मासातै ।
शते शरत्सु नो पुरा॥
verses.tr: udimāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai śate śaratsu no purā
verses.en: This date we stablish, etc.

verses.sa:
समिमां मात्रां मिमीमहे यथापरं न मासातै ।
शते शरत्सु नो पुरा॥
verses.tr: samimāṃ mātrāṃ mimīmahe yathāparaṃ na māsātai śate śaratsu no purā
verses.en: This date we mete and measure out, that it may neer be fixt again. A hundred autumns; not before,

verses.sa:
अमासि मात्रां स्वऽरगामायुष्मान् भूयासम्।
यथापरं न मासातै शते शरत्सु नो पुरा॥
verses.tr: amāsi mātrāṃ sva'ragāmāyuṣmān bhūyāsam yathāparaṃ na māsātai śate śaratsu no purā
verses.en: The period I have measured—come to heaven, I would my life were long—Not to be measured out again; a hundred autumns, not before,

verses.sa:
प्राणो अपानो व्यान आयुश्चक्षुर्दृशये सूर्याय ।
अपरिपरेण पथा यमराज्ञः पितॄन् गच्छ॥
verses.tr: prāṇo apāno vyāna āyuścakṣurdṛśaye sūryāya aparipareṇa pathā yamarājñaḥ pitṝn gaccha
verses.en: Inbreath and outbreath, breath diffused, life, sight to look upon the Sun—Seek by a straight unwinding path the Fathers whom King Yama rules,

verses.sa:
ये अग्रवः शशमानाः परेयुर्हित्वा द्वेषांस्यनपत्यवन्तः ।
ते द्यामुदित्याविदन्त लोकं नाकस्य पृष्ठे अधि दीध्यानाः॥
verses.tr: ye agravaḥ śaśamānāḥ pareyurhitvā dveṣāṃsyanapatyavantaḥ te dyāmudityāvidanta lokaṃ nākasya pṛṣṭhe adhi dīdhyānāḥ
verses.en: Unmarried men who toiled and have departed, the childless, having left their foes behind them, Have found on high the world whereto they mounted, reflecting on the ridge of vaulted heaven,

verses.sa:
उदन्वती द्यौरवमा पीलुमतीति मध्यमा।
तृतीया ह प्रद्यौरिति यस्यां पितर आसते॥
verses.tr: udanvatī dyauravamā pīlumatīti madhyamā tṛtīyā ha pradyauriti yasyāṃ pitara āsate
verses.en: The lowest is the Watery heaven, Pilumati the middlemost; The third and highest, that wherein the Fathers dwell, is called Pradyaus, l

verses.sa:
ये न पितुः पितरो ये पितामहा य आविविशुरुर्व१न्तरिक्षम्।
य आक्षियन्ति पृथिवीमुत द्यां तेभ्यः पितृभ्यो नमसा विधेम॥
verses.tr: ye na pituḥ pitaro ye pitāmahā ya āviviśururva1ntarikṣam ya ākṣiyanti pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ tebhyaḥ pitṛbhyo namasā vidhema
verses.en: The Fathers of our Father, his Grandfathers, those who have entered into air's wide region, Those who inhabit earth or dwell in heaven, these Fathers will we worship with oblation,

verses.sa:
इदमिद् वा उ नापरं दिवि पश्यसि सूर्यम्।
माता पुत्रं यथा सिचाभ्येऽनं भूम ऊर्णुहि॥
verses.tr: idamid vā u nāparaṃ divi paśyasi sūryam mātā putraṃ yathā sicābhye'naṃ bhūma ūrṇuhi
verses.en: Thou seest now, and ne'er again shalt look upon, the Sun in heaven. Cover him asa mother draws her skirt about her son, O Earth!

verses.sa:
इदमिद् वा उ नापरं जरस्यन्यदितोऽपरम्।
जाया पतिमिव वाससाभ्येऽनं भूम ऊर्णुहि॥
verses.tr: idamid vā u nāparaṃ jarasyanyadito'param jāyā patimiva vāsasābhye'naṃ bhūma ūrṇuhi
verses.en: This once, and at no other time hereafter in a lengthened life: l Cover him, as a wife, O Earth, covers her husband with her robe!

verses.sa:
अभि त्वोर्णोमि पृथिव्या मातुर्वस्त्रेण भद्रया ।
जीवेषु भद्रं तन्मयि स्वधा पितृषु सा त्वयि॥
verses.tr: abhi tvorṇomi pṛthivyā māturvastreṇa bhadrayā jīveṣu bhadraṃ tanmayi svadhā pitṛṣu sā tvayi
verses.en: Round thee auspiciously I wrap the vesture of our Mother Earth: Be bliss among the living mine, oblation mid the Fathers thine!

verses.sa:
अग्नीषोमा पथिकृता स्योनं देवेभ्यो रत्नं दधथुर्वि लोकम्।
उप प्रेष्यन्तं पूषणं यो वहात्यञ्जोयानैः पथिभिस्तत्र गच्छतम्॥
verses.tr: agnīṣomā pathikṛtā syonaṃ devebhyo ratnaṃ dadhathurvi lokam upa preṣyantaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ yo vahātyañjoyānaiḥ pathibhistatra gacchatam
verses.en: Ye have prepared, pathmakers, Agni-soma, a fair world for the Gods to be their treasure. Go to that world and send us Pushan hither to bear us on the paths the goat hath trodden.

verses.sa:
पूषा त्वेतश्च्यावयतु प्र विद्वाननष्टपशुर्भुवनस्य गोपाः ।
स त्वैतेभ्यः परि ददत् पितृभ्योऽग्निर्देवेभ्यः सुविदत्रियेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: pūṣā tvetaścyāvayatu pra vidvānanaṣṭapaśurbhuvanasya gopāḥ sa tvaitebhyaḥ pari dadat pitṛbhyo'gnirdevebhyaḥ suvidatriyebhyaḥ
verses.en: Guard of the world, whose cattle ne'er are injured, may Pushan bear thee hence, for he hath knowledge. May he consign thee to these Fathers' keeping, and to the gracious Gods let Agni give thee.

verses.sa:
आयुर्विश्वायुः परि पातु त्वा पूषा त्वा पातु प्रपथे पुरस्तात्।
यत्रासते सुकृतो यत्र त ईयुस्तत्र त्वा देवः सविता दधातु॥
verses.tr: āyurviśvāyuḥ pari pātu tvā pūṣā tvā pātu prapathe purastāt yatrāsate sukṛto yatra ta īyustatra tvā devaḥ savitā dadhātu
verses.en: Lord of all life, let Ayu guard thee, Pushan convey thee forward on the distant pathway. May Savitar the God conduct thee thither where dwell the pious who have gone before thee.

verses.sa:
इमौ युनज्मि ते वह्नी असुनीताय वोढवे ।
ताभ्यां यमस्य सादनं समितीश्चाव गच्छतात्॥
verses.tr: imau yunajmi te vahnī asunītāya voḍhave tābhyāṃ yamasya sādanaṃ samitīścāva gacchatāt
verses.en: For thee I yoke these carriers twain to bear thee to the spirit world. Hasten with them to Yama's home and join his gathered companies,

verses.sa:
एतत् त्वा वासः प्रथमं न्वागन्नपैतदूह यदिहाबिभः पुरा।
इष्टापूर्तमनुसंक्राम विद्वान् यत्र ते दत्तं बहुधा विबन्धुषु॥
verses.tr: etat tvā vāsaḥ prathamaṃ nvāgannapaitadūha yadihābibhaḥ purā iṣṭāpūrtamanusaṃkrāma vidvān yatra te dattaṃ bahudhā vibandhuṣu
verses.en: This is the robe that first was wrapped about thee: cast off the robe thou worest here among us. Go, knowing, to the meed of virtuous action, thy many gifts bestowed upon the friendless.

verses.sa:
अग्नेर्वर्म परि गोभिर्व्ययस्व सं प्रोर्णुष्व मेदसा पीवसा च ।
नेत् त्वा धृष्णुर्हरसा जर्हृषाणो दधृग् विधक्षन् परीङ्खयातै॥
verses.tr: agnervarma pari gobhirvyayasva saṃ prorṇuṣva medasā pīvasā ca net tvā dhṛṣṇurharasā jarhṛṣāṇo dadhṛg vidhakṣan parīṅkhayātai
verses.en: Mail thee with flesh against the flames of Agni; encompass thee about with fat and marrow; So will the bold One eager to attack thee with fierce glow fail to girdle and consume thee.

verses.sa:
दण्डं हस्तादाददानो गतासोः सह श्रोत्रेण वर्चसा बलेन ।
अत्रैव त्वमिह वयं सुवीरा विश्वा मृधो अभिमातीर्जयेम॥
धनुर्हस्तादाददानो मृतस्य सह क्षत्रेण वर्चसा बलेन ।
समागृभाय वसु भूरि पुष्टमर्वाङ्त्वमेह्युप जीवलोकम्॥
verses.tr: daṇḍaṃ hastādādadāno gatāsoḥ saha śrotreṇa varcasā balena atraiva tvamiha vayaṃ suvīrā viśvā mṛdho abhimātīrjayema dhanurhastādādadāno mṛtasya saha kṣatreṇa varcasā balena samāgṛbhāya vasu bhūri puṣṭamarvāṅtvamehyupa jīvalokam
verses.en: From his dead hand I take the staff he carried, together with his lore and strength and splendour, There art thou, there; and here with good men round us may we o' ercome all enemies and foemen. Go From his dead hand I take the bow he carried, together with his power and strength and splendour. Having collected wealth and ample treasure, come hither to the world of living beings.

sections.label: A funeral hymn, taken partly from the Rigveda
sections.name: Book 18, hymn 3

verses.sa:
इयं नारी पतिलोकं वृणाना नि पद्यत उप त्वा मर्त्य प्रेतम्।
धर्मं पुराणमनुपालयन्ती तस्यै प्रजां द्रविणं चेह धेहि॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ nārī patilokaṃ vṛṇānā ni padyata upa tvā martya pretam dharmaṃ purāṇamanupālayantī tasyai prajāṃ draviṇaṃ ceha dhehi
verses.en: Choosing her husband's world, O man, this woman lays herself down beside thy lifeless body. Preserving faithfully the ancient custom. Bestow upon here 'both wealth and offspring.

verses.sa:
उदीर्ष्व नार्यभि जीवलोकं गतासुमेतमुप शेष एहि ।
हस्तग्राभस्य दधिषोस्तवेदं पत्युर्जनित्वमभि सं बभूथ॥
verses.tr: udīrṣva nāryabhi jīvalokaṃ gatāsumetamupa śeṣa ehi hastagrābhasya dadhiṣostavedaṃ patyurjanitvamabhi saṃ babhūtha
verses.en: Rise, come unto the world of life, O woman: come, he is lifeless by whose side thou liest. Wifehood with this thy husband was thy portion, who took thy hand and wooed thee as a lover.

verses.sa:
अपश्यं युवतिं नीयमानां जीवां मृतेभ्यः परिणीयमानाम्।
अन्धेन यत् तमसा प्रावृतासीत् प्राक्तो अपाचीमनयं तदेनाम्॥
verses.tr: apaśyaṃ yuvatiṃ nīyamānāṃ jīvāṃ mṛtebhyaḥ pariṇīyamānām andhena yat tamasā prāvṛtāsīt prākto apācīmanayaṃ tadenām
verses.en: I looked and saw the youthful dame escorted, the living to the dead: I saw them bear her. When she with blinding darkness was enveloped, then did I turn her back and lead her homeward.

verses.sa:
प्रजानत्यऽघ्न्ये जीवलोकं देवानां पन्थामनुसंचरन्ती ।
अयं ते गोपतिस्तं जुषस्व स्वर्गं लोकमधि रोहयैनम्॥
verses.tr: prajānatya'ghnye jīvalokaṃ devānāṃ panthāmanusaṃcarantī ayaṃ te gopatistaṃ juṣasva svargaṃ lokamadhi rohayainam
verses.en: Knowing the world of living beings, Aghynya! treading the path of Gods which lies before thee, This is thy husband: joyfully receive him and let him mount into 'the world of

verses.sa:
उप द्यामुप वेतसमवत्तरो नदीनाम्।
अग्ने पित्तमपामसि॥
verses.tr: upa dyāmupa vetasamavattaro nadīnām agne pittamapāmasi
verses.en: The speed of rivers craving heaven and cane, thou, Agni, art the waters' gall,

verses.sa:
यं त्वमग्ने समदहस्तमु निर्वापया पुनः ।
क्याम्बूरत्र रोहतु शाण्डदूर्वा व्यऽल्कशा॥
verses.tr: yaṃ tvamagne samadahastamu nirvāpayā punaḥ kyāmbūratra rohatu śāṇḍadūrvā vya'lkaśā
verses.en: Cool, Agni, and again refresh the spot which thou hast scorched and burnt, Here let the water-lily grow, and tender grass and leafy plant,

verses.sa:
इदं त एकं पर ऊ त एकं तृतीयेन ज्योतिषा सं विशस्व ।
संवेशने तन्वा३ चारुरेधि प्रियो देवानां परमे सधस्थे॥
verses.tr: idaṃ ta ekaṃ para ū ta ekaṃ tṛtīyena jyotiṣā saṃ viśasva saṃveśane tanvā3 cāruredhi priyo devānāṃ parame sadhasthe
verses.en: Here is one light for thee, another yonder: enter the third and be therewith united. Uniting with a body be thou lovely, dear to the Gods in their sublimest mansion.

verses.sa:
उत् तिष्ठ प्रेहि प्र द्रवौकः कृणुष्व सलिले सधस्थे ।
तत्र त्वं पितृभिः संविदानः सं सोमेन मदस्व सं स्वधाभिः॥
verses.tr: ut tiṣṭha prehi pra dravaukaḥ kṛṇuṣva salile sadhasthe tatra tvaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ saṃ somena madasva saṃ svadhābhiḥ
verses.en: Rise up, advance, run forward: make thy dwelling in water that shall be thy place to rest in, There dwelling in accordance with the Fathers delight thyself with Soma and libations.

verses.sa:
प्र च्यवस्व तन्वं१ सं भरस्व मा ते गात्रा वि हायि मो शरीरम्।
मनो निविष्टमनुसंविशस्व यत्र भूमेर्जुषसे तत्र गच्छ॥
verses.tr: pra cyavasva tanvaṃ1 saṃ bharasva mā te gātrā vi hāyi mo śarīram mano niviṣṭamanusaṃviśasva yatra bhūmerjuṣase tatra gaccha
verses.en: Prepare thy body: speed thou on thy journey: let not thy limbs, thy frame be lef; behind thee, Follow to its repose thy resting spirit: go to whatever spot of earth thou lovest.

verses.sa:
वर्चसा मां पितरः सोम्यासो अञ्जन्तु देवा मधुना घृतेन ।
चक्षुषे मा प्रतरं तारयन्तो जरसे मा जरदष्टिं वर्धन्तु॥
verses.tr: varcasā māṃ pitaraḥ somyāso añjantu devā madhunā ghṛtena cakṣuṣe mā prataraṃ tārayanto jarase mā jaradaṣṭiṃ vardhantu
verses.en: With splendour may the Fathers, meet for Soma, with mead and fatness may the Gods anoint me, Lead me on farther to extended vision, and prosper me through life of long duration,

verses.sa:
वर्चसा मां समनक्त्वग्निर्मेधां मे विष्णुर्न्यऽनक्त्वासन्।
रयिं मे विश्वे नि यच्छन्तु देवाः स्योना मापः पवनैः पुनन्तु॥
verses.tr: varcasā māṃ samanaktvagnirmedhāṃ me viṣṇurnya'naktvāsan rayiṃ me viśve ni yacchantu devāḥ syonā māpaḥ pavanaiḥ punantu
verses.en: May Agni balm me thoroughly with splendour; may Vishnu touch my lips with understanding, May all the Deities vouchsafe me riches, and pleasant Waters purify and cleanse me.

verses.sa:
मित्रावरुणा परि मामधातामादित्या मा स्वरवो वर्धयन्तु ।
वर्चो म इन्द्रो न्यनक्तु हस्तयोर्जरदष्टिं मा सविता कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: mitrāvaruṇā pari māmadhātāmādityā mā svaravo vardhayantu varco ma indro nyanaktu hastayorjaradaṣṭiṃ mā savitā kṛṇotu
verses.en: Mitra and Varuna have stood about me. Adityas, Sacrificial Posts exalt me! May Indra balm my hands with strength and splendour. A long, long life may Savitar vouchsafe me.

verses.sa:
यो ममार प्रथमो मर्त्यानां यः प्रेयाय प्रथमो लोकमेतम्।
वैवस्वतं संगमनं जनानां यमं राजानं हविषा सपर्यत॥
verses.tr: yo mamāra prathamo martyānāṃ yaḥ preyāya prathamo lokametam vaivasvataṃ saṃgamanaṃ janānāṃ yamaṃ rājānaṃ haviṣā saparyata
verses.en: Worship with sacrificial gift King Yama, Vivasvan's f. son who gathers men together, Yama who was the first to die of mortals, the first who travelled to the world before us.

verses.sa:
परा यात पितर आ च यातायं वो यज्ञो मधुना समक्तः ।
दत्तो अस्मभ्यं द्रविणेह भद्रं रयिं च नः सर्ववीरं दधात॥
verses.tr: parā yāta pitara ā ca yātāyaṃ vo yajño madhunā samaktaḥ datto asmabhyaṃ draviṇeha bhadraṃ rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ dadhāta
verses.en: Depart, O Fathers, and again come hither: this sacrifice of yours is balmed with sweetness. Enrich us here with gift of great possessions; grant blessed wealth with ample store of heroes.

verses.sa:
कण्वः कक्षीवान् पुरुमीढो अगस्त्यः श्यावाश्वः सोभर्यर्चनानाः ।
विश्वामित्रोऽयं जमदग्निरत्रिरवन्तु नः कश्यपो वामदेवः॥
verses.tr: kaṇvaḥ kakṣīvān purumīḍho agastyaḥ śyāvāśvaḥ sobharyarcanānāḥ viśvāmitro'yaṃ jamadagniratriravantu naḥ kaśyapo vāmadevaḥ
verses.en: Kanva, Kakshivan, Purumidha, Agastya, Syavasva, Sobhari, and Archananas, This Visvamitra, Jamadagni, Atri, Kasyapa, Vamadeva be our helpers!

verses.sa:
विश्वामित्र जमदग्ने वसिष्ठ भरद्वाज गोतम वामदेव ।
शर्दिर्नो अत्रिरग्रभीन्नमोभिः सुसंशासः पितरो मृडता नः॥
verses.tr: viśvāmitra jamadagne vasiṣṭha bharadvāja gotama vāmadeva śardirno atriragrabhīnnamobhiḥ susaṃśāsaḥ pitaro mṛḍatā naḥ
verses.en: Vasishtha, Jamadagni, Visvamitra, Gotama, Vamadeva, Bharadvaja! Atri hath won your favour with our homage. Gracious to us be ye praiseworthy Fathers,

verses.sa:
कस्ये मृजाना अति यन्ति रिप्रमायुर्दधानाः प्रतरं नवीयः ।
आप्यायमानाः प्रजया धनेनाध स्याम सुरभयो गृहेषु॥
verses.tr: kasye mṛjānā ati yanti ripramāyurdadhānāḥ prataraṃ navīyaḥ āpyāyamānāḥ prajayā dhanenādha syāma surabhayo gṛheṣu
verses.en: They, making for themselves a new axis' ence, wash off defilement in the brazen vessel, May we be fragrant in our houses, ever increasing in our children and our riches.

verses.sa:
अञ्जते व्यऽञ्जते समञ्जते क्रतुं रिहन्ति मधुनाभ्यऽञ्जते ।
सिन्धोरुच्छ्वासे पतयन्तमुक्षणं हिरण्यपावाः पशुमासु गृह्णते॥
verses.tr: añjate vya'ñjate samañjate kratuṃ rihanti madhunābhya'ñjate sindhorucchvāse patayantamukṣaṇaṃ hiraṇyapāvāḥ paśumāsu gṛhṇate
verses.en: They balm him, bairn him over, balm him thoroughly, caress tho mighty power and balm it with the mead. They seize the flying steer at the stream's breathing-place: cleansing with gold they grasp the animal herein,

verses.sa:
यद् वो मुद्रं पितरः सोम्यं च तेनो सचध्वं स्वयशसो हि भूत।
ते अर्वाणः कवय आ शृणोत सुविदत्रा विदथे हूयमानाः॥
verses.tr: yad vo mudraṃ pitaraḥ somyaṃ ca teno sacadhvaṃ svayaśaso hi bhūta te arvāṇaḥ kavaya ā śṛṇota suvidatrā vidathe hūyamānāḥ
verses.en: Fathers, be glorious in yourselves, and follow all that is glad in you and meet for. Soma. Give ear and listen, swiftly-moving Sages, benevolent, invoked in our assembly.

verses.sa:
ये अत्रयो अङ्गिरसो नवग्वा इष्टावन्तो रातिषाचो दधानाः ।
दक्षिणावन्तः सुकृतो य उ स्थासद्यास्मिन् बर्हिषि मादयध्वम्॥
verses.tr: ye atrayo aṅgiraso navagvā iṣṭāvanto rātiṣāco dadhānāḥ dakṣiṇāvantaḥ sukṛto ya u sthāsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayadhvam
verses.en: Atris, Angirases, Navagvas, givers of liberal gifts, continual sacrificers, Devout and pious, granting guerdon freely, sit on this holy grass and be ye joyful.

verses.sa:
अधा यथा नः पितरः परासः प्रत्नासो अग्न ऋतमाशशानाः ।
शुचीदयन् दीध्यत उक्थशासः क्षामा भिन्दन्तो अरुणीरप व्रन्॥
verses.tr: adhā yathā naḥ pitaraḥ parāsaḥ pratnāso agna ṛtamāśaśānāḥ śucīdayan dīdhyata ukthaśāsaḥ kṣāmā bhindanto aruṇīrapa vran
verses.en: As in the days of old our ancient Fathers, speeding the work of sacred worship, Agni! Sought pure light and devotion, singing praises, they cleft the ground and made red Dawns apparent,

verses.sa:
सुकर्मानः सुरुचो देवयन्तो अयो न देवा जनिमा धमन्तः ।
शुचन्तो अग्निं वावृधन्त इन्द्रमुर्वीं गव्यां परिषदं नो अक्रन्॥
verses.tr: sukarmānaḥ suruco devayanto ayo na devā janimā dhamantaḥ śucanto agniṃ vāvṛdhanta indramurvīṃ gavyāṃ pariṣadaṃ no akran
verses.en: Gods, doing holy acts, devout, resplendent, smelting like ore their human generation, Brightening Agni and exalting Indra, they came encompassing the stall of cattle,

verses.sa:
आ यूथेव क्षुमति पश्वो अख्यद् देवानां जनिमान्त्युग्रः ।
मर्तासश्चिदुर्वशीरकृप्रन् वृधे चिदर्य उपरस्यायोः॥
verses.tr: ā yūtheva kṣumati paśvo akhyad devānāṃ janimāntyugraḥ martāsaścidurvaśīrakṛpran vṛdhe cidarya uparasyāyoḥ
verses.en: Strong One! he marked them, and the gods before them, like herds of cattle in a foodful pasture. There man moaned forth their strong desires, to strengthen even the true, the nearest One, the living,

verses.sa:
अकर्म ते स्वपसो अभूम ऋतमवस्रन्नुषसो विभातीः ।
विश्वं तद् भद्रं यदवन्ति देवा बृहद् वदेम विदथे सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: akarma te svapaso abhūma ṛtamavasrannuṣaso vibhātīḥ viśvaṃ tad bhadraṃ yadavanti devā bṛhad vadema vidathe suvīrāḥ
verses.en: We have worked for thee, we have toiled and laboured: bright Dawns have shed their light upon. our worship. All that the Gods regard with love is blessed. Loud may we speak, with heroes, in assembly,

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मा मरुत्वान् प्राच्या दिशः पातु बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: indro mā marutvān prācyā diśaḥ pātu bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyāmivopari lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: From eastward Indra, Lord of Maruts, guard me, as in her arms Earth guards the heaven above us! Those who give room, who made the paths, we worship, you, mid the Gods, who share the gifts we offer,

verses.sa:
धाता मा निरृत्या दक्षिणाया दिशः पातु बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: dhātā mā nirṛtyā dakṣiṇāyā diśaḥ pātu bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyāmivopari lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Dhatar with Nirriti save me from southward, etc. (as in stanza 25).

verses.sa:
अदितिर्मादित्यैः प्रतीच्या दिशः पातु बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: aditirmādityaiḥ pratīcyā diśaḥ pātu bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyāmivopari lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: From westward Aditi with Adityas save me! etc,

verses.sa:
सोमो मा विश्वैर्देवैरुदीच्या दिशः पातु बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: somo mā viśvairdevairudīcyā diśaḥ pātu bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyāmivopari lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: From westward with the All-gods save me Soma I etc.

verses.sa:
धर्ता ह त्वा धरुणो धारयाता ऊर्ध्वं भानुं सविता द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: dhartā ha tvā dharuṇo dhārayātā ūrdhvaṃ bhānuṃ savitā dyāmivopari lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: May the strong firm Sustainer bear thee upright, as Savitar bears light above the heaven. Those who give room, who made the paths, we worship, you, mid the Gods, who share the gifts we our,

verses.sa:
प्राच्यां त्वा दिशि पुरा संवृतः स्वधायामा दधामि बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: prācyāṃ tvā diśi purā saṃvṛtaḥ svadhāyāmā dadhāmi bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyāmivopari lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Toward the eastward region I supply thee, before thou goest homeward, with oblation, as in her arms, etc. (as in stanza 25).

verses.sa:
दक्षिणायां त्वा दिशि पुरा संवृतः स्वधायामा दधामि बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: dakṣiṇāyāṃ tvā diśi purā saṃvṛtaḥ svadhāyāmā dadhāmi bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyāmivopari lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Toward the southern region, etc. Strong One! O mighty Agrii. He marked them: Indra saw the kine or imprisoned days. The Gods before them: the divine Angirases

verses.sa:
प्रतीच्यां त्वा दिशि पुरा संवृतः स्वधायामा दधामि बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: pratīcyāṃ tvā diśi purā saṃvṛtaḥ svadhāyāmā dadhāmi bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyāmivopari lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Toward the western region, etc.

verses.sa:
उदीच्यां त्वा दिशि पुरा संवृतः स्वधायामा दधामि बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: udīcyāṃ tvā diśi purā saṃvṛtaḥ svadhāyāmā dadhāmi bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyāmivopari lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Toward the northern region, etc,

verses.sa:
ध्रुवायां त्वा दिशि पुरा संवृतः स्वधायामा दधामि बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: dhruvāyāṃ tvā diśi purā saṃvṛtaḥ svadhāyāmā dadhāmi bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyāmivopari lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Toward the stedfast region, etc.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वायां त्वा दिशि पुरा संवृतः स्वधायामा दधामि बाहुच्युता पृथिवी द्यामिवोपरि ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvāyāṃ tvā diśi purā saṃvṛtaḥ svadhāyāmā dadhāmi bāhucyutā pṛthivī dyāmivopari lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Toward the upmost region I supply thee, before thou goest homeward, with oblation, as in her arms Earth bears the heaven above us. 'Those who give room, who made the paths, we worship, you, mid the Gods, who share the gifts we offer.

verses.sa: धर्तासि धरुणोऽसि वंसगोऽसि॥
verses.tr: dhartāsi dharuṇo'si vaṃsago'si
verses.en: Thou art the Bull, Supporter, and Upholder,

verses.sa: उदपूरसि मधुपूरसि वातपूरसि॥
verses.tr: udapūrasi madhupūrasi vātapūrasi
verses.en: Who purifiest wind and mead and water,

verses.sa:
इतश्च मामुतश्चावतां यमे इव यतमाने यदैतम्।
प्र वां भरन् मानुषा देवयन्तो आ सीदतां स्वमु लोकं विदाने॥
verses.tr: itaśca māmutaścāvatāṃ yame iva yatamāne yadaitam pra vāṃ bharan mānuṣā devayanto ā sīdatāṃ svamu lokaṃ vidāne
verses.en: From this side and from that let both assist me, As, speeding, ye have come like two twin sisters, Religious-hearted votaries brought you forward, Knowing your several places be ye seated,

verses.sa:
स्वासस्थे भवतमिन्दवे नो युजे वां ब्रह्म पूर्व्यं नमोभिः ।
वि श्लोक एति पथ्येऽव सूरिः शृण्वन्तु विश्वे अमृतास एतत्॥
verses.tr: svāsasthe bhavatamindave no yuje vāṃ brahma pūrvyaṃ namobhiḥ vi śloka eti pathye'va sūriḥ śṛṇvantu viśve amṛtāsa etat
verses.en: Sit near, sit very near beside our Soma: for you I fit the ancient prayer with homage. The praise-song, like a chieftain on his pathway, spreads far and wide, Let all Immortals hear it.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि पदानि रुपो अन्वरोहच्चतुष्पदीमन्वैतद् व्रतेन ।
अक्षरेण प्रति मिमीते अर्कमृतस्य नाभावभि सं पुनाति॥
verses.tr: trīṇi padāni rupo anvarohaccatuṣpadīmanvaitad vratena akṣareṇa prati mimīte arkamṛtasya nābhāvabhi saṃ punāti
verses.en: Three paces hath the stake gone up, and followed her, the four-footed, with devout observance. He with the Syllable copies the praise-song: he thoroughly purifies at Order's centre,

verses.sa:
देवेभ्यः कमवृणीत मृत्युं प्रजायै किममृतं नावृणीत ।
बृहस्पतिर्यज्ञमतनुत ऋषिः प्रियां यमस्तन्व१मा रिरेच॥
verses.tr: devebhyaḥ kamavṛṇīta mṛtyuṃ prajāyai kimamṛtaṃ nāvṛṇīta bṛhaspatiryajñamatanuta ṛṣiḥ priyāṃ yamastanva1mā rireca
verses.en: Chose he then, death for Gods to be their portion? Why chose he not for men a life eternal? Brihaspati span sacrifice, the Rishi; and Yama yielded up his own dear body,

verses.sa:
त्वमग्न ईडितो जातवेदोऽवाड्ढव्यानि सुरभीणि कृत्वा।
प्रादाः पितृभ्यः स्वधया ते अक्षन्नद्धि त्वं देव प्रयता हवींषि॥
verses.tr: tvamagna īḍito jātavedo'vāḍḍhavyāni surabhīṇi kṛtvā prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣannaddhi tvaṃ deva prayatā havīṃṣi
verses.en: Thou, Agni Jatavedas, when entreated, didst bear our offerings, having made them fragrant, And give them to the Fathers who consumed them with Svadha, Eat, thou God, the gifts we bring thee.

verses.sa:
आसीनासो अरुणीनामुपस्थे रयिं धत्त दाशुषे मर्त्याय ।
पुत्रेभ्यः पितरस्तस्य वस्वः प्र यच्छत त इहोर्जं दधात॥
verses.tr: āsīnāso aruṇīnāmupasthe rayiṃ dhatta dāśuṣe martyāya putrebhyaḥ pitarastasya vasvaḥ pra yacchata ta ihorjaṃ dadhāta
verses.en: Lapped in the bosom of the purple Mornings, give riches to the man who brings oblation. Grant to your sons a portion of that treasure, and, present, give them energy, O Fathers.

verses.sa:
अग्निष्वात्ताः पितर एह गच्छत सदःसदः सदत सुप्रणीतयः ।
अत्तो हवींषि प्रयतानि बर्हिषि रयिं च नः सर्ववीरं दधात॥
verses.tr: agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥsadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ atto havīṃṣi prayatāni barhiṣi rayiṃ ca naḥ sarvavīraṃ dadhāta
verses.en: Fathers whom Agni's flames have tasted, come ye nigh: in perfect order take ye each your proper place. Eat sacrificial food presented on the grass: grant riches with a multitude of hero sons,

verses.sa:
उपहूता नः पितरः सोम्यासो बर्हिष्येऽषु निधिषु प्रियेषु ।
त आ गमन्तु त इह श्रुवन्त्वधि ब्रुवन्तु तेऽवन्त्वस्मान्॥
verses.tr: upahūtā naḥ pitaraḥ somyāso barhiṣye'ṣu nidhiṣu priyeṣu ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantvadhi bruvantu te'vantvasmān
verses.en: May they, the Fathers who deserve the Soma, invited to their favourite oblations: Laid on the sacred grass, come nigh and listen. May they be gracious unto us and. bless us.

verses.sa:
ये नः पितुः पितरो ये पितामहा अनूजहिरे सोमपीथं वसिष्ठाः ।
तेभिर्यमः संरराणो हवींष्युशन्नुशद्भिः प्रतिकाममत्तु॥
verses.tr: ye naḥ pituḥ pitaro ye pitāmahā anūjahire somapīthaṃ vasiṣṭhāḥ tebhiryamaḥ saṃrarāṇo havīṃṣyuśannuśadbhiḥ pratikāmamattu
verses.en: Our Father's Fathers and their sires before them who came, most noble, to the Soma banquet, With these let Yama, yearning with the yearning, rejoicing eat our offerings at his pleasure.

verses.sa:
ये तातृषुर्देवत्रा जेहमाना होत्राविदः स्तोमतष्टासो अर्कैः ।
आग्ने याहि सहस्रं देववन्दैः सत्यैः कविभिर्ऋषिभिर्घर्मसद्भिः॥
verses.tr: ye tātṛṣurdevatrā jehamānā hotrāvidaḥ stomataṣṭāso arkaiḥ āgne yāhi sahasraṃ devavandaiḥ satyaiḥ kavibhirṛṣibhirgharmasadbhiḥ
verses.en: Come to us, Agni, with the gracious Fathers who dwell in glowing light, the very Sages, Who thirsted mid the Gods, who hasten hither, oblation-winners, theme of singers' praises.

verses.sa:
ये सत्यासो हविरदो हविष्पा इन्द्रेण देवैः सरथं तुरेण ।
आग्ने याहि सुविदत्रेभिरर्वाङ् परैः पूर्वैर्ऋषिभिर्घर्मसद्भिः॥
verses.tr: ye satyāso havirado haviṣpā indreṇa devaiḥ sarathaṃ tureṇa āgne yāhi suvidatrebhirarvāṅ paraiḥ pūrvairṛṣibhirgharmasadbhiḥ
verses.en: Come, Agni, come with countless ancient Fathers, dwellers in light, primeval, God-adorers, Eaters and drinkers of oblation, truthful, who. travel with the Deities and Indra. i

verses.sa:
उप सर्प मातरं भूमिमेतामुरुव्यचसं पृथिवीं सुशेवाम्।
ऊर्णम्रदाः पृथिवी दक्षिणावत एषा त्वा पातु प्रपथे पुरस्तात्॥
verses.tr: upa sarpa mātaraṃ bhūmimetāmuruvyacasaṃ pṛthivīṃ suśevām ūrṇamradāḥ pṛthivī dakṣiṇāvata eṣā tvā pātu prapathe purastāt
verses.en: Betake thee to the lap of Earth, our mother, j of Earth far-spreading, very kind and gracious. May she, wool-soft unto the guerdon-giver, guard thee in front upon the distant pathway.

verses.sa:
उच्छ्वञ्चस्व पृथिवि मा नि बाधथाः सूपायनास्मै भव सूपसर्पणा।
माता पुत्रं यथा सिचाभ्येऽनं भूम ऊर्णुहि॥
verses.tr: ucchvañcasva pṛthivi mā ni bādhathāḥ sūpāyanāsmai bhava sūpasarpaṇā mātā putraṃ yathā sicābhye'naṃ bhūma ūrṇuhi
verses.en: Heave thyself, Earth, nor press him downward heavily: afford him easy access, pleasant to approach. Cover him asa mother wraps her skirt about her child, O Earth!

verses.sa:
उच्छ्वञ्चमाना पृथिवी सु तिष्ठतु सहस्रं मित उप हि श्रयन्ताम्।
ते गृहासो घृतश्चुतः स्योना विश्वाहास्मै शरणाः सन्त्वत्र॥
verses.tr: ucchvañcamānā pṛthivī su tiṣṭhatu sahasraṃ mita upa hi śrayantām te gṛhāso ghṛtaścutaḥ syonā viśvāhāsmai śaraṇāḥ santvatra
verses.en: Now let the heaving earth be free from motion: yea, let a thousand clods remain above him. Be they to him a home distilling fatness: here let them ever be his place of refuge,

verses.sa:
उत् ते स्तभ्नामि पृथिवीं त्वत् परीमं लोगं निदधन्मो अहं रिषम्।
एतां स्थूणां पितरो धारयन्ति ते तत्र यमः सादना ते कृणोतु॥
verses.tr: ut te stabhnāmi pṛthivīṃ tvat parīmaṃ logaṃ nidadhanmo ahaṃ riṣam etāṃ sthūṇāṃ pitaro dhārayanti te tatra yamaḥ sādanā te kṛṇotu
verses.en: I stay the earth from thee, while over thee I place this piece of earth, May I be free from injury. The Fathers firmly fix this pillar here for tbee; and there let Yama make thee an abiding-place.

verses.sa:
इममग्ने चमसं मा वि जिह्वरः प्रियो देवानामुत सोम्यानाम्।
अयं यश्चमसो देवपानस्तस्मिन् देवा अमृता मादयन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: imamagne camasaṃ mā vi jihvaraḥ priyo devānāmuta somyānām ayaṃ yaścamaso devapānastasmin devā amṛtā mādayantām
verses.en: Forbear, O Agni, to upset this chalice: the Gods and they who merit Soma love it. This cup, yea this which serves the Gods to drink from,—in this let the Immortals take their pleasure.

verses.sa:
अथर्वा पूर्णं चमसं यमिन्द्रायाबिभर्वाजिनीवते ।
तस्मिन् कृणोति सुकृतस्य भक्षं तस्मिनिन्दुः पवते विश्वदानीम्॥
verses.tr: atharvā pūrṇaṃ camasaṃ yamindrāyābibharvājinīvate tasmin kṛṇoti sukṛtasya bhakṣaṃ tasmininduḥ pavate viśvadānīm
verses.en: The chalice brimming o'er which erst Atharvan offered to Indra, Lord of wealth and treasure, Indu therein sets draught of virtuous action, and ever purifies himself within it.

verses.sa:
यत् ते कृष्णः शकुन आतुतोद पिपीलः सर्प उत वा श्वापदः ।
अग्निष्टद् विश्वादगदं कृणोतु सोमश्च यो ब्राह्मणां आविवेश॥
verses.tr: yat te kṛṣṇaḥ śakuna ātutoda pipīlaḥ sarpa uta vā śvāpadaḥ agniṣṭad viśvādagadaṃ kṛṇotu somaśca yo brāhmaṇāṃ āviveśa
verses.en: What wound soe'er the dark bird hath inflicted, the emmet, or the serpent, or the jackal, May Agni who devoureth all things heal it, and Soma who hath passed into the Brahmans.

verses.sa:
पयस्वतीरोषधयः पयस्वन्मामकं पयः ।
अपां पयसो यत् पयस्तेन मा सह शुम्भतु॥
verses.tr: payasvatīroṣadhayaḥ payasvanmāmakaṃ payaḥ apāṃ payaso yat payastena mā saha śumbhatu
verses.en: The plants of earth are rich in milk, and rich in milk is this my milk. With all the milky essence ofthe Waters let them make me clean,

verses.sa:
इमा नारीरविधवाः सुपत्नीराञ्जनेन सर्पिषा सं स्पृशन्ताम्।
अनश्रवो अनमीवाः सुरत्ना आ रोहन्तु जनयो योनिमग्रे॥
verses.tr: imā nārīravidhavāḥ supatnīrāñjanena sarpiṣā saṃ spṛśantām anaśravo anamīvāḥ suratnā ā rohantu janayo yonimagre
verses.en: Let these unwidowed dames with goodly husbands adorn themselves with fragrant balm and unguent. Decked with fair jewels, tearless, free, from trouble, first let the dames go up to where he lieth.

verses.sa:
सं गच्छस्व पितृभिः सं यमेनेष्टापूर्तेन परमे व्योऽमन्।
हित्वावद्यं पुनरस्तमेहि सं गच्छतां तन्वाऽ सुवर्चाः॥
verses.tr: saṃ gacchasva pitṛbhiḥ saṃ yameneṣṭāpūrtena parame vyo'man hitvāvadyaṃ punarastamehi saṃ gacchatāṃ tanvā' suvarcāḥ
verses.en: Meet Yama, meet the Fathers, meet the merit of virtuous action in the loftiest heaven. Leave sin and evil, seek anew thy dwelling: so bright with glory let him join his body.

verses.sa:
ये नः पितुः पितरो ये पितामहा य आविविशुरुर्व१न्तरिक्षम्।
तेभ्यः स्वराडसुनीतिर्नो अद्य वथावशं तन्वः कल्पयाति॥
verses.tr: ye naḥ pituḥ pitaro ye pitāmahā ya āviviśururva1ntarikṣam tebhyaḥ svarāḍasunītirno adya vathāvaśaṃ tanvaḥ kalpayāti
verses.en: Our Father's Fathers and their sires before them, they who have entered into air's wide region, For them shall self-resplendent Asuniti form bodies now according to her pleasure.

verses.sa:
शं ते नीहारो भवतु शं ते प्रुष्वाव शीयताम्।
शीतिके शीतिकावति ह्लादिके ह्लादिकावति ।
मण्डूक्य१प्सु शं भुव इमं स्व१ग्निं शमय॥
verses.tr: śaṃ te nīhāro bhavatu śaṃ te pruṣvāva śīyatām śītike śītikāvati hlādike hlādikāvati maṇḍūkya1psu śaṃ bhuva imaṃ sva1gniṃ śamaya
verses.en: Let the hoar-frost be sweet to thee, sweetly on thee the rain descend! O full of coolness, thou cool Plant, full of fresh moisture, freshening Herb, Bless us in waters, female Frog: calm and allay this Agni here,

verses.sa:
विवस्वान्नो अभयं कृणोतु यः सुत्रामा जीरदानुः सुदानुः ।
इहेमे वीरा बहवो भवन्तु गोमदश्ववन्मय्यस्तु पुष्टम्॥
verses.tr: vivasvānno abhayaṃ kṛṇotu yaḥ sutrāmā jīradānuḥ sudānuḥ iheme vīrā bahavo bhavantu gomadaśvavanmayyastu puṣṭam
verses.en: Vivasvan make us free from fear and peril, good rescuer, quick-pouring, bounteous giver! Many in number be these present heroes! Increase of wealth be mine in kine and horses!

verses.sa:
विवस्वान् नो अमृतत्वे दधातु परैतु मृत्युरमृतं न ऐतु ।
इमान् रक्षतु पुरुषाना जरिम्णो मो ष्वेऽषामसवो यमं गुः॥
verses.tr: vivasvān no amṛtatve dadhātu paraitu mṛtyuramṛtaṃ na aitu imān rakṣatu puruṣānā jarimṇo mo ṣve'ṣāmasavo yamaṃ guḥ
verses.en: In immortality Vivasvan set us! Go from us Death, come to us life eternal! To good old age may he protect these people: let not their spirits pass away to Yama.

verses.sa:
यो दध्रे अन्तरिक्षे न मह्ना पितॄणां कविः प्रमतिर्मतीनाम्।
तमर्चत विश्वमित्रा हविर्भिः स नो यमः प्रतरं जीवसे धात्॥
verses.tr: yo dadhre antarikṣe na mahnā pitṝṇāṃ kaviḥ pramatirmatīnām tamarcata viśvamitrā havirbhiḥ sa no yamaḥ prataraṃ jīvase dhāt
verses.en: The Sage of Fathers, guardian of devotions who holds thee up with might in air's mid-region,—Praise him ye Visvamitras, with oblation. To lengthened life shall he, this Yama, lead us.

verses.sa:
आ रोहत दिवमुत्तमामृषयो मा बिभीतन ।
सोमपाः सोमपायिन इदं वः क्रियते हविरगन्म ज्वोतिरुत्तमम्॥
verses.tr: ā rohata divamuttamāmṛṣayo mā bibhītana somapāḥ somapāyina idaṃ vaḥ kriyate haviraganma jvotiruttamam
verses.en: Mount and ascend to highest heaven, O Rishis: be ye not afraid, Soma-drinkers to you is paid this Soma-lover's sacrifice. We have attained the loftiest light,

verses.sa:
प्र केतुना बृहता भात्यग्निरा रोदसी वृषभो रोरवीति ।
दिवश्चिदन्तादुपमामुदानडपामुपस्थे महिषो ववर्ध॥
verses.tr: pra ketunā bṛhatā bhātyagnirā rodasī vṛṣabho roravīti divaścidantādupamāmudānaḍapāmupasthe mahiṣo vavardha
verses.en: Agni is shining forth with lofty banner: the Bull is bellowing to earth and heaven. From the sky's limit even hath he stretched near us: the Steer hath waxen in the waters' bosom.

verses.sa:
नाके सुपर्णमुप यत् पतन्तं हृदा वेनन्तो अभ्यचक्षत त्वा ।
हिरण्यपक्षं वरुणस्य दूतं यमस्य यो नौ शकुनं भुरण्युम्॥
verses.tr: nāke suparṇamupa yat patantaṃ hṛdā venanto abhyacakṣata tvā hiraṇyapakṣaṃ varuṇasya dūtaṃ yamasya yo nau śakunaṃ bhuraṇyum
verses.en: They gaze on thee with longing in their spirit, as on an eagle that is mounting skyward; On thee with wings of gold, Varuna's envoy, the Bird that hasteth to the home of Yama.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र क्रतुं न आ भर पिता पुत्रेभ्यो यथा ।
शिक्षा णो अस्मिन् पुरुहूत यामनि जीवा ज्योतिरशीमहि॥
verses.tr: indra kratuṃ na ā bhara pitā putrebhyo yathā śikṣā ṇo asmin puruhūta yāmani jīvā jyotiraśīmahi
verses.en: O Indra, bring us wisdom as a sire gives wisdom to his sons. Guide us, O much-invoked in this our way: may we still living look upon the Sun,

verses.sa:
अपूपापिहितान् कुम्भान् यांस्ते देवा अधारयन्।
ते ते सन्तु स्वधावन्तो मधुमन्तो घृतश्चुतः॥
verses.tr: apūpāpihitān kumbhān yāṃste devā adhārayan te te santu svadhāvanto madhumanto ghṛtaścutaḥ
verses.en: Let these which Gods have held for thee, the beakers covered o'er with cake, Be full of sacred food for thee, distilling fatness, rich in mead,

verses.sa:
यास्ते धाना अनुकिरामि तिलमिश्रा स्वधावतीः ।
तास्ते सन्तु विभ्वीः प्रभ्वीस्तास्ते यमो राजानु मन्यताम्॥
verses.tr: yāste dhānā anukirāmi tilamiśrā svadhāvatīḥ tāste santu vibhvīḥ prabhvīstāste yamo rājānu manyatām
verses.en: Grains which for thee I scatter, mixt with Sesamum, as holy food,—May they for thee be excellent and potent: King Yama look on them as thine with favour!

verses.sa:
पुनर्देहि वनस्पते य एष निहितस्त्वयि ।
यथा यमस्य सादन आसातै विदथा वदन्॥
verses.tr: punardehi vanaspate ya eṣa nihitastvayi yathā yamasya sādana āsātai vidathā vadan
verses.en: O Tree, give back again this man who is deposited on thee, That he may dwell in Yama's home addressing the assemblies there. e a nn ne EEEEEEEEEEPenee

verses.sa:
आ रभस्व जातवेदस्तेजस्वद्धरो अस्तु ते ।
शरीरमस्य सं दहाथैनं धेहि सुकृतामु लोके॥
verses.tr: ā rabhasva jātavedastejasvaddharo astu te śarīramasya saṃ dahāthainaṃ dhehi sukṛtāmu loke
verses.en: Seize hold, O Jatavedas; let thy flame be full offer-vent heat. Consume his body: to the world of pious ones transport this man. l

verses.sa:
ये ते पूर्वे परागता अपरे पितरश्च ये।
तेभ्यो घृतस्य कुल्यैऽतु शतधारा व्युन्दती॥
verses.tr: ye te pūrve parāgatā apare pitaraśca ye tebhyo ghṛtasya kulyai'tu śatadhārā vyundatī
verses.en: To these, thy Fathers who have passed away at first and afterward, Let the full brook of butter run, o'erflowing with a hundred streams,

verses.sa:
एतदा रोह वय उन्मृजानः स्वा इह बृहदु दीदयन्ते ।
अभि प्रेहि मध्यतो माप हास्थाः पितॄनां लोकं प्रथमो यो अत्र॥
verses.tr: etadā roha vaya unmṛjānaḥ svā iha bṛhadu dīdayante abhi prehi madhyato māpa hāsthāḥ pitṝnāṃ lokaṃ prathamo yo atra
verses.en: Mount to this life, removing: all defilement: here thine own kindred shine with lofty splendour. Depart thou; be not left behind: go forward, first of those here, unto the world of Fathers,

sections.label: A funeral hymn, composed partly of verses from the rigveda
sections.name: Book 18, hymn 4

verses.sa:
आ रोहत जनित्रीं जातवेदसः पितृयाणैः सं व आ रोहयामि ।
अवाड्ढव्येषितो हव्यवाह ईजानं युक्ताः सुकृतां धत्त लोके॥
verses.tr: ā rohata janitrīṃ jātavedasaḥ pitṛyāṇaiḥ saṃ va ā rohayāmi avāḍḍhavyeṣito havyavāha ījānaṃ yuktāḥ sukṛtāṃ dhatta loke
verses.en: Rise to your mother, flames of Jatavedas! I send you up by paths which Fathers traverse. With headlong speed the Oblation-bearer bore our gifts: toil ye, and place the offerer where the righteous dwell.

verses.sa:
देवा यज्ञमृतवः कल्पयन्ति हविः पुरोडाशं स्रुचो यज्ञायुधानि ।
तेभिर्याहि पथिभिर्देवयानैर्यैरीजानाः स्वर्गं यन्ति लोकम्॥
verses.tr: devā yajñamṛtavaḥ kalpayanti haviḥ puroḍāśaṃ sruco yajñāyudhāni tebhiryāhi pathibhirdevayānairyairījānāḥ svargaṃ yanti lokam
verses.en: The Seasons, Deities, form and order Worship, butter, cake, ladles, sacrificial weapons, Tread thou God-travelled paths whereby the righteous, payers of sacrifices, go to Svarga.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य पन्थामनु पश्य साध्वङ्गिरसः सुकृतो येन यन्ति ।
तेभिर्याहि पथिभिः स्वर्गं यत्रादित्या मधु भक्षयन्ति तृतीये नाके अधि वि श्रयस्व॥
