verses.tr: ṛtasya panthāmanu paśya sādhvaṅgirasaḥ sukṛto yena yanti tebhiryāhi pathibhiḥ svargaṃ yatrādityā madhu bhakṣayanti tṛtīye nāke adhi vi śrayasva
verses.en: Carefully look on Sacrificed pathway whereon the Angirases, the righteous, travel, By those same pathways go thou up to Svarga where the Adityas take their fill of sweetness, There make thy home in the third vault of heaven.

verses.sa:
त्रयः सुपर्णा उपरस्य मायू नाकस्य पृष्ठे अधि विष्टपि श्रिताः ।
स्वर्गा लोका अमृतेन विष्ठा इषमूर्जं यजमानाय दुह्राम्॥
verses.tr: trayaḥ suparṇā uparasya māyū nākasya pṛṣṭhe adhi viṣṭapi śritāḥ svargā lokā amṛtena viṣṭhā iṣamūrjaṃ yajamānāya duhrām
verses.en: Three eagles in the region's roar are standing high on heaven's ridge in their appointed station, The worlds of Svarga shall, filled full of Amrit, yield food and power to him who sacrificeth.

verses.sa:
जुहूर्दाधार द्यामुपभृदन्तरिक्षं ध्रुवा दाधार पृथिवीं प्रतिष्ठाम्।
प्रतीमां लोका घृतपृष्ठाः स्वर्गाः कामंकामं यजमानाय दुह्राम्॥
verses.tr: juhūrdādhāra dyāmupabhṛdantarikṣaṃ dhruvā dādhāra pṛthivīṃ pratiṣṭhām pratīmāṃ lokā ghṛtapṛṣṭhāḥ svargāḥ kāmaṃkāmaṃ yajamānāya duhrām
verses.en: Upabhrit stablished air, Juhu the heaven, Dhruva supported earth securely founded. As meed, the Svarga worlds, o'erspread with fatness shall yield the sacrificer all his wishes,

verses.sa:
ध्रुव आ रोह पृथिवीं विश्वभोजसमन्तरिक्षमुपभृदा क्रमस्व ।
जुहु द्यां गच्छ यजमानेन साकं स्रुवेण वत्सेन दिशः प्रपीनाः सर्वा धुक्ष्वाहृण्यमानः॥
verses.tr: dhruva ā roha pṛthivīṃ viśvabhojasamantarikṣamupabhṛdā kramasva juhu dyāṃ gaccha yajamānena sākaṃ sruveṇa vatsena diśaḥ prapīnāḥ sarvā dhukṣvāhṛṇyamānaḥ
verses.en: Dhruva, ascend thou earth the all-sustainer: go thou, O Upabhrit, to air's mid-region. Juha, go skyward with the sacrificer; go, and with Sruva as thy calf beside thee drain all the swelling unreluctant quarters.

verses.sa:
तीर्थैस्तरन्ति प्रवतो महीरिति यज्ञकृतः सुकृतो येन यन्ति ।
अत्रादधुर्यजमानाय लोकं दिशो भूतानि यदकल्पयन्त॥
verses.tr: tīrthaistaranti pravato mahīriti yajñakṛtaḥ sukṛto yena yanti atrādadhuryajamānāya lokaṃ diśo bhūtāni yadakalpayanta
verses.en: They ford the mighty rivers by the pathway which they who sacrifice, the righteous, travel. There they gave room unto the sacrificer when they, made regions and existing creatures.

verses.sa:
अङ्गिरसामयनं पूर्वो अग्निरादित्यानामयनं गार्हपत्यो दक्षिणानामयनं दक्षिणाग्निः ।
महिमानमग्नेर्विहितस्य ब्रह्मणा समङ्गः सर्व उप याहि शग्मः॥
verses.tr: aṅgirasāmayanaṃ pūrvo agnirādityānāmayanaṃ gārhapatyo dakṣiṇānāmayanaṃ dakṣiṇāgniḥ mahimānamagnervihitasya brahmaṇā samaṅgaḥ sarva upa yāhi śagmaḥ
verses.en: The Angirases' pathway is the esstern Agni, the Adityas pathway is the Garhapatya: The southward Agni is the way of Southerns. To Agni's greatness whom the prayer divideth go powerful, unscathed, with all thy members.

verses.sa:
पूर्वो अग्निष्ट्वा तपतु शं पुरस्ताच्छं पश्चात् तपतु गार्हपत्यः ।
दक्षिणाग्निष्टे तपतु शर्म वर्मोत्तरतो मध्यतो अन्तरिक्षाद् दिशोदिशो अग्ने परि पाहि घोरात्॥
verses.tr: pūrvo agniṣṭvā tapatu śaṃ purastācchaṃ paścāt tapatu gārhapatyaḥ dakṣiṇāgniṣṭe tapatu śarma varmottarato madhyato antarikṣād diśodiśo agne pari pāhi ghorāt
verses.en: Eastward let east fire happily consume thee, and westward happily the Garhapatya. Burn southern fire, thine armour and protection: from air's mid-region from the north and centre, on all sides, Agni, guard thou him from horror.

verses.sa:
यूयमग्ने शंतमाभिस्तनूभिरीजानमभि लोकं स्वर्गम्।
अश्वा भूत्वा पृष्टिवाहो वहाथ यत्र देवैः सधमादं मदन्ति॥
verses.tr: yūyamagne śaṃtamābhistanūbhirījānamabhi lokaṃ svargam aśvā bhūtvā pṛṣṭivāho vahātha yatra devaiḥ sadhamādaṃ madanti
verses.en: Do ye, with your most kindly forms, O Agni, waft, turned to rapid steeds whose ribs bear burthens, The sacrificer to the world of Svarga where with the Gods they banquet and are joyful.

verses.sa:
शमग्ने पश्चात् तप शं पुरस्ताच्छमुत्तराच्छमधरात् तपैनम्।
एकस्त्रेधा विहितो जातवेदः सम्यगेनं धेहि सुकृतामु लोके॥
verses.tr: śamagne paścāt tapa śaṃ purastācchamuttarācchamadharāt tapainam ekastredhā vihito jātavedaḥ samyagenaṃ dhehi sukṛtāmu loke
verses.en: I Happily from the rear burn this man, Agni, happily from before, above, and under. y One; triply parted, Jatavedas, place him happily in the world that holds the righteous,

verses.sa:
शमग्नयः समिद्धा आ रभन्तां प्राजापत्यं मेध्यं जातवेदसः ।
शृतं कृण्वन्त इह माव चिक्षिपन्॥
verses.tr: śamagnayaḥ samiddhā ā rabhantāṃ prājāpatyaṃ medhyaṃ jātavedasaḥ śṛtaṃ kṛṇvanta iha māva cikṣipan
verses.en: Happily lit, let fires, each Jatavedas, seize on Prajapati's appointed victim. l Let them not cast it down while here they cook it,

verses.sa:
यज्ञ एति विततः कल्पमान ईजानमभि लोकं स्वर्गम्।
तमग्नयः सर्वहुतं जुषन्तां प्राजापत्यं मेध्यं जातवेदसः॥
verses.tr: yajña eti vitataḥ kalpamāna ījānamabhi lokaṃ svargam tamagnayaḥ sarvahutaṃ juṣantāṃ prājāpatyaṃ medhyaṃ jātavedasaḥ
verses.en: Sacrifice, duly offered, comes preparing the sacrificer for the world of Svarga. Let all the fires, each Jatavedas, welcome Prajapati's completely offered victim, Let them not cast it down while here they cook it.

verses.sa:
ईजानश्चितमारुक्षदग्निं नाकस्य पृष्ठाद् दिवमुत् पतिष्यन्।
तस्मै प्र भाति नभसो ज्योतिषीमान्त्स्वर्गः पन्थाः सुकृते देवयानः॥
verses.tr: ījānaścitamārukṣadagniṃ nākasya pṛṣṭhād divamut patiṣyan tasmai pra bhāti nabhaso jyotiṣīmāntsvargaḥ panthāḥ sukṛte devayānaḥ
verses.en: Fain to fly up from the sky's ridge to heaven, the worshipper hath mounted visible Agni. Lucid from out the mist to him, the pious, gleams the God-travelled path that leads to Svarga.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्होताध्वर्युष्टे बहस्पतिरिन्द्रो ब्रह्मा दक्षिणतस्ते अस्तु ।
हुतोऽयं संस्थितो यज्ञ एति यत्र पूर्वमयनं हुतानाम्॥
verses.tr: agnirhotādhvaryuṣṭe bahaspatirindro brahmā dakṣiṇataste astu huto'yaṃ saṃsthito yajña eti yatra pūrvamayanaṃ hutānām
verses.en: On thy right hand let Indra be thy Brahman, Brihaspati Adhvaryu, Agni Hotar. This ordered sacrifice goes offered thither whither presented gifts have gone aforetime.

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् क्षीरवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: apūpavān kṣīravāṃścarureha sīdatu lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Enriched with cake and milk here let the Charu rest. World-makers, makers. of the path, we worship you of the Gods who here partake oblations.

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् दधिवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: apūpavān dadhivāṃścarureha sīdatu lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Enriched with cake and curds, etc. (as in stanza 16),

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् द्रप्सवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: apūpavān drapsavāṃścarureha sīdatu lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Enriched with cake and drops, etc,

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् घृतवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: apūpavān ghṛtavāṃścarureha sīdatu lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Enriched with cake and butter, etc,

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् मांसवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: apūpavān māṃsavāṃścarureha sīdatu lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Enriched with cake and flesh, etc.

verses.sa:
अपूपवानन्नवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: apūpavānannavāṃścarureha sīdatu lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Enriched with cake and food, etc.

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् मधुमांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: apūpavān madhumāṃścarureha sīdatu lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: 'Enriched with cake and mead, etc,

verses.sa:
अपूपवान् रसवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: apūpavān rasavāṃścarureha sīdatu lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Enriched with cake and juice, etc,

verses.sa:
अपूपवानपवांश्चरुरेह सीदतु ।
लोककृतः पथिकृतो यजामहे ये देवानां हुतभागा इह स्थ॥
verses.tr: apūpavānapavāṃścarureha sīdatu lokakṛtaḥ pathikṛto yajāmahe ye devānāṃ hutabhāgā iha stha
verses.en: Here, mixt with cake and water rest the Charu! World-makers, makers of the path, we worship those Gods of you who here partake oblations.

verses.sa:
अपूपापिहितान् कुम्भान् यांस्ते देवा अधारयन्।
ते ते सन्तु स्वधावन्तो मधुमन्तो घृतश्चुतः॥
verses.tr: apūpāpihitān kumbhān yāṃste devā adhārayan te te santu svadhāvanto madhumanto ghṛtaścutaḥ
verses.en: Let these which Gods have held for thee, these beakers covered o'er with cake, Be full of sacred food for thee, distilling fatness, rich in mead.

verses.sa:
यास्ते धाना अनुकिरामि तिलमिश्राः स्वधावतीः ।
तास्ते सन्तूद्भ्वीः प्रभ्वीस्तास्ते यमो राजानु मन्यताम्॥
verses.tr: yāste dhānā anukirāmi tilamiśrāḥ svadhāvatīḥ tāste santūdbhvīḥ prabhvīstāste yamo rājānu manyatām
verses.en: Grains which for thee I scatter, mixt with Sesamum, as holy food,—May they for thee be excellent and potent, King Yama look on them as thine with favour!

verses.sa: अक्षितिं भूयसीम्॥
verses.tr: akṣitiṃ bhūyasīm
verses.en: More immortality! a

verses.sa:
द्रप्सश्चस्कन्द पृथिवीमनु द्यामिमं च योनिमनु यश्च पूर्वः ।
समानं योनिमनु संचरन्तं द्रप्सं जुहोम्यनु सप्त होत्राः॥
verses.tr: drapsaścaskanda pṛthivīmanu dyāmimaṃ ca yonimanu yaśca pūrvaḥ samānaṃ yonimanu saṃcarantaṃ drapsaṃ juhomyanu sapta hotrāḥ
verses.en: On all the earth, to heaven, the drop descended, on this place and on that which was before it. I offer up, throughout the seven oblations, the drop which still to one same place is moving.

verses.sa:
शतधारं वायुमर्कं स्वर्विदं नृचक्षसस्ते अभि चक्षते रयिम्।
ये पृणन्ति प्र च यच्छन्ति सर्वदा ते दुह्रते दक्षिणां सप्तमातरम्॥
verses.tr: śatadhāraṃ vāyumarkaṃ svarvidaṃ nṛcakṣasaste abhi cakṣate rayim ye pṛṇanti pra ca yacchanti sarvadā te duhrate dakṣiṇāṃ saptamātaram
verses.en: Those who observe men look on wealth as Vayu with countless streams, and as light-finding Arka; Those drain out Guerdon sprung from seven mothers, who satisfy and evermore give presents,

verses.sa:
कोशं दुहन्ति कलशं चतुर्बिलमिडां धेनुं मधुमतीं स्वस्तये ।
ऊर्जं मदन्तीमदितिं जनेष्वग्ने मा हिंसीः परमे व्योऽमन्॥
verses.tr: kośaṃ duhanti kalaśaṃ caturbilamiḍāṃ dhenuṃ madhumatīṃ svastaye ūrjaṃ madantīmaditiṃ janeṣvagne mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyo'man
verses.en: They for their weal drain out the cask, the beaker four-holed, the milch-cow Ida full of sweetness. Injure not, Agni, in the loftiest heaven Aditi heightening strength among the people.

verses.sa:
एतत् ते देवः सविता वासो ददाति भर्तवे ।
तत् त्वं यमस्य राज्ये वसानस्तार्प्यंऽ चर॥
verses.tr: etat te devaḥ savitā vāso dadāti bhartave tat tvaṃ yamasya rājye vasānastārpyaṃ' cara
verses.en: On thee doth Savitar the God bestow this vesture for thy wear. Clothe thee herein, and find meet robe in Yama's realm to cover thee,

verses.sa:
धाना धेनुरभवद् वत्सो अस्यास्तिलोऽभवत्।
तां वै यमस्य राज्ये अक्षितामुप जीवति॥
verses.tr: dhānā dhenurabhavad vatso asyāstilo'bhavat tāṃ vai yamasya rājye akṣitāmupa jīvati
verses.en: The grains of corn have now become a cow, the Sesamum her calf. He in the realm of Yama lives on her the inexhaustible.

verses.sa:
एतास्ते असौ धेनवः कामदुघा भवन्तु ।
एनीः श्येनीः सरूपा विरूपास्तिलवत्सा उप तिष्ठन्तु त्वात्र॥
verses.tr: etāste asau dhenavaḥ kāmadughā bhavantu enīḥ śyenīḥ sarūpā virūpāstilavatsā upa tiṣṭhantu tvātra
verses.en: Let these become thy milch-kine, man! supplying all thy heart's desires. There, speckled, white, like-hued and various-coloured, with calves of Sesamum let them stand beside thee.

verses.sa:
एनीर्धाना हरिणीः श्येनीरस्य कृष्णा धाना रोहिणीर्धेनवस्ते ।
तिलवत्सा ऊर्जमस्मै दुहाना विश्वाहा सन्त्वनपस्फुरन्तीः॥
verses.tr: enīrdhānā hariṇīḥ śyenīrasya kṛṣṇā dhānā rohiṇīrdhenavaste tilavatsā ūrjamasmai duhānā viśvāhā santvanapasphurantīḥ
verses.en: Let the green grains become thy white and speckled, the dusky corns become thy ruddy milch-kine. Let those with calves 'of Sesamum for: ever yield strength to him and never flinch from milking.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरे हविरिदं जुहोमि साहस्रं शतधारमुत्सम्।
स बिभर्ति पितरं पितामहान् प्रपितामहान् बिभर्ति पिन्वमानः॥
verses.tr: vaiśvānare haviridaṃ juhomi sāhasraṃ śatadhāramutsam sa bibharti pitaraṃ pitāmahān prapitāmahān bibharti pinvamānaḥ
verses.en: I offer in Vaisvanara this oblation, thousandfold spring that pours a hundred streamlets, This with a swelling flow supports the Father, supports grandfathers and their sires before them,

verses.sa:
सहस्रधारं शतधारमुत्समक्षितं व्यच्यमानं सलिलस्य पृष्ठे।
ऊर्जं दुहानमनपस्फुरन्तमुपासते पितरः स्वधाभिः॥
verses.tr: sahasradhāraṃ śatadhāramutsamakṣitaṃ vyacyamānaṃ salilasya pṛṣṭhe ūrjaṃ duhānamanapasphurantamupāsate pitaraḥ svadhābhiḥ
verses.en: Beside the spring with hundred, thousand currents, expanding on the summit of the water, Exhaustless, yielding strength, never reluctant, the Fathers with their sacred food are seated.

verses.sa:
इदं कसाम्बु चयनेन चितं तत् सजाता अव पश्यतेत ।
मर्त्योऽयममृतत्वमेति तस्मै गृहान् कृणुत यावत्सबन्धु॥
verses.tr: idaṃ kasāmbu cayanena citaṃ tat sajātā ava paśyateta martyo'yamamṛtatvameti tasmai gṛhān kṛṇuta yāvatsabandhu
verses.en: This pile of wood, collected, heaped together, regard it, O ye kinsmen, and come near it. To immortality this mortal goeth: prepare a home for him, all ye his kindred.

verses.sa:
इहैवैधि धनसनिरिहचित्त इहक्रतुः ।
इहैधि वीर्यऽवत्तरो वयोधा अपराहतः॥
verses.tr: ihaivaidhi dhanasanirihacitta ihakratuḥ ihaidhi vīrya'vattaro vayodhā aparāhataḥ
verses.en: Be here, even here, acquiring wealth, here be thou thought, here be thou strength, Be stronger here in manly power, life-giver, never beaten back.

verses.sa:
पुत्रं पौत्रमभितर्पयन्तीरापो मधुमतीरिमाः ।
स्वधां पितृभ्यो अमृतं दुहाना आपो देवीरुभयांस्तर्पयन्तु॥
verses.tr: putraṃ pautramabhitarpayantīrāpo madhumatīrimāḥ svadhāṃ pitṛbhyo amṛtaṃ duhānā āpo devīrubhayāṃstarpayantu
verses.en: Giving the son and grandson satisfaction, let these the present Waters full of sweetness, Pouring forth food and Amrit for the Fathers, refresh both these and those, the Goddess Waters,

verses.sa:
आपो अग्निं प्र हिणुत पितॄंरुपेमं यज्ञं पितरो मे जुषन्ताम्।
आसीनामूर्जमुप ये सचन्ते ते नो रयिं सर्ववीरं नि यच्छान्॥
verses.tr: āpo agniṃ pra hiṇuta pitṝṃrupemaṃ yajñaṃ pitaro me juṣantām āsīnāmūrjamupa ye sacante te no rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yacchān
verses.en: Waters, send Agni forward to the Fathers: let them accept the sacrifice I offer, May they who follow Vigour that abideth there send us down wealth with full store of heroes,

verses.sa:
समिन्धते अमर्त्यं हव्यवाहं घृतप्रियम्।
स वेद निहितान्निधीन् पितॄन् परावतो गतान्॥
verses.tr: samindhate amartyaṃ havyavāhaṃ ghṛtapriyam sa veda nihitānnidhīn pitṝn parāvato gatān
verses.en: Lover of butter, deathless, him, Oblation-bearer, they inflame. He knoweth well the treasured stores gone to the Fathers, far away.

verses.sa:
यं ते मन्थं यमोदनं यन्मांसं निपृणामि ते ।
ते ते सन्तु स्वधावन्तो मधुमन्तो घृतश्चुतः॥
verses.tr: yaṃ te manthaṃ yamodanaṃ yanmāṃsaṃ nipṛṇāmi te te te santu svadhāvanto madhumanto ghṛtaścutaḥ
verses.en: The mingled draught. the mess of rice, the flesh which I present to thee, May these be full of food for thee, distilling fatness, rich in sweets.

verses.sa:
यास्ते धाना अनुकिरामि तिलमिश्राः स्वधावतीः ।
तास्ते सन्तूद्भ्वीः प्रभ्वीस्तास्ते यमो राजानु मन्यताम्॥
verses.tr: yāste dhānā anukirāmi tilamiśrāḥ svadhāvatīḥ tāste santūdbhvīḥ prabhvīstāste yamo rājānu manyatām
verses.en: Grains which for thee I scatter, mixt with Sesamum, as sacred food, i; May these for thee be excellent and potent, King Yama look on them, as thine, with favour.

verses.sa:
इदं पूर्वमपरं नियानं येना ते पूर्वे पितरः परेताः ।
पुरोगवा ये अभिशाचो अस्य ते त्वा वहन्ति सुकृतामु लोकम्॥
verses.tr: idaṃ pūrvamaparaṃ niyānaṃ yenā te pūrve pitaraḥ paretāḥ purogavā ye abhiśāco asya te tvā vahanti sukṛtāmu lokam
verses.en: This is the ancient, this the recent pathway, by which thy sires of olden time departed. They who first travelled it, and they who followed, convey thee to the world where dwell the righteous.

verses.sa:
सरस्वतीं देवयन्तो हवन्ते सरस्वतीमध्वरे तायमाने ।
सरस्वतीं सुकृतो हवन्ते सरस्वती दाशुषे वार्यं दात्॥
verses.tr: sarasvatīṃ devayanto havante sarasvatīmadhvare tāyamāne sarasvatīṃ sukṛto havante sarasvatī dāśuṣe vāryaṃ dāt
verses.en: The pious call Sarasvati: they worship Sarasvati while sacrifice proceedeth. f The righteous doers of good deeds invoke her: Sarasvati send bliss to him who giveth.

verses.sa:
सरस्वतीं पितरो हवन्ते दक्षिणा यज्ञमभिनक्षमाणाः ।
आसद्यास्मिन् बर्हिषि मादयध्वमनमीवा इष आ धेह्यस्मे॥
verses.tr: sarasvatīṃ pitaro havante dakṣiṇā yajñamabhinakṣamāṇāḥ āsadyāsmin barhiṣi mādayadhvamanamīvā iṣa ā dhehyasme
verses.en: Approaching on the south our solemn worship, the Fathers call Sarasvati to hear them, Sit on this holy grass and be ye joyful: give thou us strengthening food that brings no sickness.

verses.sa:
सरस्वति या सरथं ययाथोक्थैः स्वधाभिर्देवि पितृभिर्मदन्ती ।
सहस्रार्घमिडो अत्र भागं रायस्पोषं यजमानाय धेहि॥
verses.tr: sarasvati yā sarathaṃ yayāthokthaiḥ svadhābhirdevi pitṛbhirmadantī sahasrārghamiḍo atra bhāgaṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ yajamānāya dhehi
verses.en: Sarasvati, who earnest with them, joying in hymns and food, O Goddess, with the Fathers, Here give the Sacrificer growth of riches, a portion, worth a thousand, of refreshment,

verses.sa:
पृथिवीं त्वा पृथिव्यामा वेशयामि देवो नो धाता प्र तिरात्यायुः ।
परापरैता वसुविद् वो अस्त्वधा मृताः पितृषु सं भवन्तु॥
verses.tr: pṛthivīṃ tvā pṛthivyāmā veśayāmi devo no dhātā pra tirātyāyuḥ parāparaitā vasuvid vo astvadhā mṛtāḥ pitṛṣu saṃ bhavantu
verses.en: As Prithivi rests on earth, so do I seat thee, May the God Dhatar lengthen our existence, Al They inflame: men kindle Agni. For you may he who parts in turn find treasures, but ieb the Dead remain among the Fathers.

verses.sa:
आ प्र च्यवेथामप तन्मृजेथां यद् वामभिभा अत्रोचुः ।
अस्मादेतमघ्न्यौ तद् वशीयो दातुः पितृष्विहभोजनौ मम॥
verses.tr: ā pra cyavethāmapa tanmṛjethāṃ yad vāmabhibhā atrocuḥ asmādetamaghnyau tad vaśīyo dātuḥ pitṛṣvihabhojanau mama
verses.en: Depart ye two: wipe ye away whatever omens of evil fortune here have told you. Go from this man, both Steers, to him who wills it: ye are my joys here by the giver's Fathers.

verses.sa:
एयमगन् दक्षिणा भद्रतो नो अनेन दत्ता सुदुघा वयोधाः ।
यौवने जीवानुपपृञ्चती जरा पितृभ्य उपसंपराणयादिमान्॥
verses.tr: eyamagan dakṣiṇā bhadrato no anena dattā sudughā vayodhāḥ yauvane jīvānupapṛñcatī jarā pitṛbhya upasaṃparāṇayādimān
verses.en: From a good quarter have we gained this guerdon, gift of this man, strength-giving, plenteous milker. Bringing in youth old age unto the living, may she bear these together to the Fathers.

verses.sa:
इदं पितृभ्यः प्र भरामि बर्हिर्जीवं देवेभ्य उत्तरं स्तृणामि ।
तदा रोह पुरुष मेध्यो भवन् प्रति त्वा जानन्तु पितरः परेतम्॥
verses.tr: idaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ pra bharāmi barhirjīvaṃ devebhya uttaraṃ stṛṇāmi tadā roha puruṣa medhyo bhavan prati tvā jānantu pitaraḥ paretam
verses.en: I bring this clipped grass hither for the Fathers: grass living, higher, for the Gods I scatter, Mount this, O man, as victim: let the Fathers recognize thee when thou hast travelled yonder.

verses.sa:
एदं बर्हिरसदो मेध्योऽभूः प्रति त्वा जानन्तु पितरः परेतम्।
यथापरु तन्वं१ सं भरस्व गात्राणि ते ब्रह्मणा कल्पयामि॥
verses.tr: edaṃ barhirasado medhyo'bhūḥ prati tvā jānantu pitaraḥ paretam yathāparu tanvaṃ1 saṃ bharasva gātrāṇi te brahmaṇā kalpayāmi
verses.en: Set on this grass thou hast become a victim, Fathers. Shall know thee yonder when they meet thee. i Gather thy body, limb by limb, together: I by the power of prayer arrange thy members.

verses.sa:
पर्णो राजापिधानं चरूणामूर्जो बलं सह ओजो न आगन्।
आयुर्जीवेभ्यो विदधद् दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय॥
verses.tr: parṇo rājāpidhānaṃ carūṇāmūrjo balaṃ saha ojo na āgan āyurjīvebhyo vidadhad dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya
verses.en: The royal Parna is the caldrons' cover: strength have we gained, force, power, and might, and vigour, Bestowing length of life upon the living, for long i existence through a hundred autumns.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जो भागो य इमं जजानाश्मान्नानामाधिपत्यं जगाम ।
तमर्चत विश्वमित्रा हविर्भिः स नो यमः प्रतरं जीवसे धात्॥
verses.tr: ūrjo bhāgo ya imaṃ jajānāśmānnānāmādhipatyaṃ jagāma tamarcata viśvamitrā havirbhiḥ sa no yamaḥ prataraṃ jīvase dhāt
verses.en: The share; of vigour which gave this man being, the stone won lordship over foods that nourish. Hymn this with your oblations, Visvamitras: may he, may Yama, lengthen our existence.

verses.sa:
यथा यमाय हर्म्यमवपन् पञ्च मानवाः ।
एवा वपामि हर्म्यं यथा मे भूरयोऽसत॥
verses.tr: yathā yamāya harmyamavapan pañca mānavāḥ evā vapāmi harmyaṃ yathā me bhūrayo'sata
verses.en: As the Five Races of mankind for Yama set apart a house. Even so I set a house apart that greater numbers may be mine,

verses.sa:
इदं हिरण्यं बिभृहि यत् ते पिताबिभः पुरा।
स्वर्गं यतः पितुर्हस्तं निर्मृड्ढि दक्षिणम्॥
verses.tr: idaṃ hiraṇyaṃ bibhṛhi yat te pitābibhaḥ purā svargaṃ yataḥ piturhastaṃ nirmṛḍḍhi dakṣiṇam
verses.en: Take thou and wear this piece of gold, the gold thy father used to wear, Wipe tenderly the right hand of thy sire who goes away to heaven,

verses.sa:
ये च जीवा ये च मृता ये जाता ये च यज्ञियाः ।
तेभ्यो घृतस्य कुल्यैऽतु मधुधारा व्युन्दती॥
verses.tr: ye ca jīvā ye ca mṛtā ye jātā ye ca yajñiyāḥ tebhyo ghṛtasya kulyai'tu madhudhārā vyundatī
verses.en: To all, the living and the dead, all that are born, the worshipful, Let the full brook of fatness run, o'erflowing, with a stream of mead,

verses.sa:
वृषा मतीनां पवते विचक्षणः सूरो अह्नां प्रतरीतोषसां दिवः ।
प्राणः सिन्धूनां कलशाँ अचिक्रददिन्द्रस्य हार्दिमाविशन् मनीषया॥
verses.tr: vṛṣā matīnāṃ pavate vicakṣaṇaḥ sūro ahnāṃ pratarītoṣasāṃ divaḥ prāṇaḥ sindhūnāṃ kalaśāṃ acikradadindrasya hārdimāviśan manīṣayā
verses.en: Far-seeing he flows on, the Bull, the Lord of hymns; promoter of the Sun, of Days, of Dawns, of Heaven, Breath of the rivers, he hath roared into the jars, and through his wisdom entered into Indra's heart.

verses.sa:
त्वेषस्ते धूम ऊर्णोतु दिवि षंच्छुक्र आततः ।
सूरो न हि द्युता त्वं कृपा पावक रोचसे॥
verses.tr: tveṣaste dhūma ūrṇotu divi ṣaṃcchukra ātataḥ sūro na hi dyutā tvaṃ kṛpā pāvaka rocase
verses.en: Let thy bright smoke envelop thee, spread forth, O Bright One, in the sky, For, Purifier, like the Sun thou shinest with thy radiant glow.

verses.sa:
प्र वा एतीन्दुरिन्द्रस्य निष्कृतिं सखा सख्युर्न प्र मिनाति संगिरः ।
मर्य इव योषाः समर्षसे सोमः कलशे शतयामना पथा॥
verses.tr: pra vā etīndurindrasya niṣkṛtiṃ sakhā sakhyurna pra mināti saṃgiraḥ marya iva yoṣāḥ samarṣase somaḥ kalaśe śatayāmanā pathā
verses.en: Indu is moving forth to Indra's destined place, and slights not as a friend the promise of his friend. Thou, Soma, comest nigh as bridegroom meets the bride, reaching the beaker by a course of hundred paths.

verses.sa:
अक्षन्नमीमदन्त ह्यव प्रियां अधूषत ।
अस्तोषत स्वभानवो विप्रा यविष्ठा ईमहे॥
verses.tr: akṣannamīmadanta hyava priyāṃ adhūṣata astoṣata svabhānavo viprā yaviṣṭhā īmahe
verses.en: Well have they eaten and rejoiced: their dear ones have they shaken off, Sages, self luminous, have praised; we who are youngest supplicate,

verses.sa:
आ यात पितरः सोम्यासो गम्भीरैः पथिभिः पितृयाणैः ।
आयुरस्मभ्यं दधतः प्रजां च रायश्च पोषैरभि नः सचध्वम्॥
verses.tr: ā yāta pitaraḥ somyāso gambhīraiḥ pathibhiḥ pitṛyāṇaiḥ āyurasmabhyaṃ dadhataḥ prajāṃ ca rāyaśca poṣairabhi naḥ sacadhvam
verses.en: Come hither, Fathers, who deserve the Soma, by the deep pathways which the Fathers travel. Bestow upon us life and store of children, and favour us with increase of our riches.

verses.sa:
परा यात पितरः सोम्यासो गम्भीरैः पथिभिः पूर्याणैः ।
अधा मासि पुनरा यात नो गृहान् हविरत्तुं सुप्रजसः सुवीराः॥
verses.tr: parā yāta pitaraḥ somyāso gambhīraiḥ pathibhiḥ pūryāṇaiḥ adhā māsi punarā yāta no gṛhān havirattuṃ suprajasaḥ suvīrāḥ
verses.en: Depart, O Fathers, ye who merit Soma, by the deep pathways which the Fathers travel; But in a month, rich in fair sons- and heroes, come back into our homes to eat oblation.

verses.sa:
यद् वो अग्निरजहादेकमङ्गं पितृलोकं गमयं जातवेदाः ।
तद् व एतत् पुनरा प्याययामि साङ्गाः स्वर्गे पितरो मादयध्वम्॥
verses.tr: yad vo agnirajahādekamaṅgaṃ pitṛlokaṃ gamayaṃ jātavedāḥ tad va etat punarā pyāyayāmi sāṅgāḥ svarge pitaro mādayadhvam
verses.en: If Agni Jatavedas, as he bore you hence to the Fathers, world, hath left one single Limb of your bodies, here do I restore it, Fathers, rejoice in heaven with all your members!

verses.sa:
अभूद् दूतः प्रहितो जातवेदाः सायं न्यह्न उपवन्द्यो नृभिः ।
प्रादाः पितृभ्यः स्वधया ते अक्षन्नद्धि त्वं देव प्रयता हवींषि॥
verses.tr: abhūd dūtaḥ prahito jātavedāḥ sāyaṃ nyahna upavandyo nṛbhiḥ prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣannaddhi tvaṃ deva prayatā havīṃṣi
verses.en: Meet for men's praises, Agni Jatavedas was sent as. envoy when the day was closing. Thou gavest to the Fathers with oblation. They ate; eat, God, our offered sacrifices.

verses.sa:
असौ हा इह ते मनः ककुत्सलमिव जामयः ।
अभ्येऽनं भूम ऊर्णुहि॥
verses.tr: asau hā iha te manaḥ kakutsalamiva jāmayaḥ abhye'naṃ bhūma ūrṇuhi
verses.en: Here hast thou left thy heart; O man, as sisters leave their little pst. Do thou, O earth, envelop him,

verses.sa: शुम्भन्तां लोकाः पितृषदनाः पितृषदने त्वा लोक आ सादयामि॥
verses.tr: śumbhantāṃ lokāḥ pitṛṣadanāḥ pitṛṣadane tvā loka ā sādayāmi
verses.en: Bright be to thee those worlds where dwell the Fathers! I I seat thee in that sphere which they inhabit.

verses.sa: ये३स्माकं पितरस्तेषां बर्हिरसि॥
verses.tr: ye3smākaṃ pitarasteṣāṃ barhirasi
verses.en: Thou art the grass whereon our Fathers seat them,

verses.sa:
उदुत्तमं वरुण पाशमस्मदवाधमं वि मध्यमं श्रथाय ।
अधा वयमादित्य व्रते तवानागसो अदितये स्याम॥
verses.tr: uduttamaṃ varuṇa pāśamasmadavādhamaṃ vi madhyamaṃ śrathāya adhā vayamāditya vrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma
verses.en: Loosen, O Varuna, the bond that binds us; loosen the bond above, between, and under. Then under thy protection, O Aditya, may we be sinless and restored to freedom,

verses.sa:
प्रास्मत् पाशान् वरुण मुञ्च सर्वान् यैः समामे बध्यते यैर्व्यामे।
अधा जीवेम शरदं शतानि त्वया राजन् गुपिता रक्षमाणाः॥
verses.tr: prāsmat pāśān varuṇa muñca sarvān yaiḥ samāme badhyate yairvyāme adhā jīvema śaradaṃ śatāni tvayā rājan gupitā rakṣamāṇāḥ
verses.en: u From all those bonds, O Varuna, release us, wherewith a man is bound at length and cross-wise. Then may we live a hundrad autumn seasons guarded by thee, O King, by thee protected,

verses.sa: अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्वधा नमः॥
verses.tr: agnaye kavyavāhanāya svadhā namaḥ
verses.en: To Agni, bearer of oblation to the Manes, be Hail! and homage!

verses.sa: सोमाय पितृमते स्वधा नमः॥
verses.tr: somāya pitṛmate svadhā namaḥ
verses.en: To Soma connected with the Fathers Hail! and homage!

verses.sa: पितृभ्यः सोमवद्भ्यः स्वधा नमः॥
verses.tr: pitṛbhyaḥ somavadbhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ
verses.en: To the Fathers connected with Soma Hail! and homage!

verses.sa: यमाय पितृमते स्वधा नमः॥
verses.tr: yamāya pitṛmate svadhā namaḥ
verses.en: To Yama connected with the Fathers Hail! and homage!

verses.sa: एतत् ते प्रततामह स्वधा ये च त्वामनु॥
verses.tr: etat te pratatāmaha svadhā ye ca tvāmanu
verses.en: To thee, O Great-grandfather, and those with thee be this cry of Hail!

verses.sa: एत् ते ततामह स्वधा ये च त्वामनु॥
verses.tr: et te tatāmaha svadhā ye ca tvāmanu
verses.en: To thee, Grandfather, and to those with thee be this cry of Hail!

verses.sa: एतत् ते तत स्वधा॥
verses.tr: etat te tata svadhā
verses.en: To thee, O Fathers, be this cry of Hail!

verses.sa: स्वधा पितृभ्यः पृथिविषद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: svadhā pitṛbhyaḥ pṛthiviṣadbhyaḥ
verses.en: Hail to the Fathers who inhabit earth.

verses.sa: स्वधा पितृभ्यो अन्तरिक्षसद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: svadhā pitṛbhyo antarikṣasadbhyaḥ
verses.en: Hail to the Fathers who inhabit the firmament!

verses.sa: स्वधा पितृभ्यो दिविषद्भ्यः॥
verses.tr: svadhā pitṛbhyo diviṣadbhyaḥ
verses.en: Hail to the Fathers who dwell in heaven!

verses.sa: नमो वः पितर ऊर्जे नमो वः पितरो रसाय॥
verses.tr: namo vaḥ pitara ūrje namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya
verses.en: Hail, Fathers, to your energy! Hail, Fathers, to your sap!

verses.sa: नमो वः पितरो भामाय नमो वः पितरो मन्यवे॥
verses.tr: namo vaḥ pitaro bhāmāya namo vaḥ pitaro manyave
verses.en: Hail Father, to your wrath! Hail, Fathers, to your ardour!

verses.sa: नमो वः पितरो यद् घोरं तस्मै नमो वः पितरो यत् क्रूरं तस्मै॥
verses.tr: namo vaḥ pitaro yad ghoraṃ tasmai namo vaḥ pitaro yat krūraṃ tasmai
verses.en: Hail, Fathers, to what is awful! Hail to what is terrible in you!

verses.sa: नमो वः पितरो यच्छिवं तस्मै नमो वः पितरो यत् स्योनं तस्मै॥
verses.tr: namo vaḥ pitaro yacchivaṃ tasmai namo vaḥ pitaro yat syonaṃ tasmai
verses.en: Hail, Fathers, to all that is propitious! Hail to all that is pleasant in you!

verses.sa: नमो वः पितरः स्वधा वः पितरः॥
verses.tr: namo vaḥ pitaraḥ svadhā vaḥ pitaraḥ
verses.en: Homage to you, Fathers! Hail to you, Fathers!

verses.sa: येऽत्र पितरः पितरो येऽत्र यूयं स्थ युष्मांस्तेऽनु यूयं तेषां श्रेष्ठा भूयास्थ॥
verses.tr: ye'tra pitaraḥ pitaro ye'tra yūyaṃ stha yuṣmāṃste'nu yūyaṃ teṣāṃ śreṣṭhā bhūyāstha
verses.en: All Fathers who are here, the Fathers here are you: let them follow you. May ye be the most excellent of these,

verses.sa:
य इह पितरो जीवा इह वयं स्मः ।
अस्मांस्तेऽनु वयं तेषां श्रेष्ठा भूयास्म॥
verses.tr: ya iha pitaro jīvā iha vayaṃ smaḥ asmāṃste'nu vayaṃ teṣāṃ śreṣṭhā bhūyāsma
verses.en: All living fathers who are here are we here: let them follow us.. May we be the most excellent of these.

verses.sa:
आ त्वाग्न इधीमहि द्युमन्तं देवाजरम्।
यद् घ सा ते पनीयसी समिद् दीदयति द्यवि ।
इषं स्तोतृभ्य आ भर॥
verses.tr: ā tvāgna idhīmahi dyumantaṃ devājaram yad gha sā te panīyasī samid dīdayati dyavi iṣaṃ stotṛbhya ā bhara
verses.en: Bright Agni, we will kindle thee, rich in thy splendour, fading not, So that this glorious fuel may send forth to heaven its light for thee. Bring food to those who sing thy praise,

verses.sa:
चन्द्रमा अप्स्व१न्तरा सुपर्णो धावते दिवि।
न वो हिरण्यनेमयः पदं विन्दन्ति विद्युतो वित्तं मे अस्य रोदसी॥
verses.tr: candramā apsva1ntarā suparṇo dhāvate divi na vo hiraṇyanemayaḥ padaṃ vindanti vidyuto vittaṃ me asya rodasī
verses.en: Within the waters runs the Moon, the strong-winged Eagle soars in heaven. Ye Lightnings with your golden wheels, men find not your abiding-place, Hear this my call, O Heaven and Earth.
